jobs.title: Associate Director of Marketing for Digital Communications Platforms
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Associate Director of Marketing

**REPORTS TO:** Executive Director of Marketing

**EXPECTED SALARY RANGE:** $65,000 – 75,000; plus The University of Vermont Foundation’s progressive benefits package, which includes a comprehensive health plan; dental, vision, and life insurance; a robust paid time off package; a 403(b) plan with immediate vesting and contributions; and tuition remission.

**EFFECTIVE DATE:** November 15, 2026, or a mutually agreed-upon start date

**FTE:** Full-Time

**LOCATION:** Burlington, Vermont

**JOB-TYPE/HOURS:** Hybrid. The UVM Foundation operates on a 3-2 hybrid schedule which allows employees to work 2 days per week from a local remote location. Specific schedules are discussed with and approved by supervisors.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Associate Director of Marketing for Digital Communication Platforms manages the organization's website, email marketing, and text messaging platforms to advance the philanthropic and alumni engagement missions of the UVM Foundation and UVM Alumni Association. This role serves as the organization's primary subject matter expert for digital communications platforms, ensuring content is strategic, audience-focused, data-informed, and aligned with organizational goals.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Marketing, the Associate Director is responsible for the administration, optimization, governance, and ongoing enhancement of the Foundation's digital communication channels, including the website, email marketing platform, and texting platform. The position provides strategic guidance and technical support to colleagues across the organization while leveraging analytics and best practices to improve engagement, user experience, and campaign performance.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**40%** Manage, Update, and Optimize the UVM Foundation website

* Serve as primary administrator for the UVM Foundation website, overseeing content updates, site structure, accuracy, functionality, accessibility, and user experience while aligning with brand standards.
* Collaborate with marketing colleagues and content owners across the organization to create, update, and publish website content across the organization.
* Monitor website performance and user behavior using Google Analytics and platform reporting tools; collect data and provide recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes.
* Lead ongoing efforts to enhance website usability, accessibility, search engine optimization (SEO), and overall user experience.
* Develop and maintain website governance processes, content standards, workflows, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve landing pages, donation pathways, event registration experiences, and other high-priority user journeys.
* Troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with vendors or technical partners as needed to ensure optimal platform performance.

**40%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Email Marketing

* Serve as primary administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's email marketing platform.
* Develop and maintain email marketing standards, templates, processes, and best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Build and deploy email communications and sequences while providing guidance and strategic support to staff responsible for creating and sending their own messages.
* Collect and review email performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve open rates, click-through rates, audience engagement, and conversion outcomes.
* Develop audience segmentation strategies that deliver more relevant and targeted communications.
* Establishing and enacting thoughtful data maintenance and hygiene processes, including conducting A/B performance testing, as well as creating dashboards or other reporting mechanisms to help stakeholders evaluate campaign effectiveness in service of making data-informed decisions. Ensure compliance with applicable privacy, consent, and email marketing regulations and best practices.
* Monitor emerging trends and technologies in email marketing and implement enhancements where appropriate.

**15%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Texting

* Serve as administrator for the organization's texting platforms and help establish a long-term strategy for text-based engagement.
* Develop processes, standards, and best practices governing the use of SMS communications across the organization.
* Partner with fundraising, alumni engagement, and event teams to expand texting initiatives to include event reminders, volunteer engagement, stewardship, and other strategic communications.
* Monitor engagement and response metrics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for growth.
* Ensure compliance with applicable consent, privacy, and communication requirements.
* Develop reporting tools and recommendations that support continuous improvement of texting efforts.

**5****%** Other duties as assigned

**MINIMUM SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* Experience managing content within a website content management system (CMS).
* Experience creating, deploying, and evaluating email marketing campaigns.
* Experience using analytics tools to measure performance and inform decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Design sensibilities preferred and experience adhering to branding guidelines.
* Collaborative approach to working across teams.
* Demonstrated commitment to the principles of diversity, equity and inclusion, combined with the ability to meaningfully apply those principles to strategy development and implementation.

  

**PREFERRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree and at least 2-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital communications, email marketing, website management, and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skill, and abilities have been developed.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**What You’ll Do**

You’ll own the social media engine that accelerates Prep Network’s subscription success — shaping how we speak, publish, and show up across all channels. You’ll guide the daily output for Prep Network's subscription brands, support new initiatives like Prep Scores, and collaborate with our event marketing team to maximize reach, strengthen storytelling, and drive meaningful growth.

You’ll build and manage the full social calendar for our digital brands, publish a high volume of engaging content highlighting our articles, rankings, features, and recruiting guidance. You’ll partner closely with video and graphics teams to turn ideas into scroll-stopping assets, and you’ll guide our digital social contributors and VAs with clear briefs, expectations, and posting standards.

**Who We Are**

Prep Network is a sports company that connects high school athletes with college coaches. Through our nine brands, we publish over 4,000 articles each month and actively scout talented athletes across the U.S. We aim to discover and promote promising prospects who aspire to play at the collegiate level.

In addition to our content, Prep Network is the top event operator in the U.S., hosting 200+ tournaments annually. We offer a combination of top-tier competitions and extensive media exposure for attending teams. Our 250+ showcases each year provide a platform for over 10,000+ prospects to compete in front of colleges, scouts, and media outlets.

We’re pumped to have been named one of the "Best Places to Work" by Minneapolis/St. Paul Business Journal for five years running, and to land a spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Prep Network isn’t your average sports company; we’re all about helping student-athletes succeed and creating an awesome workplace.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Plans and Publishes the Daily Content Calendar Across All Brands:** builds and runs the weekly calendar for multiple social channels across all brands, building brand awareness and promoting articles, ranking drops, recruiting and commitment news, scores and subscription features, engagement posts, and product updates.
* **Sets and Executes Brand Voice and Community Engagement Across Channels:** writes copy in each brand’s voice, defines tone and engagement standards, models them in day-to-day community engagement responding to comments and messages, and reviews team content for quality and consistency.
* **Shapes Briefs and Leads Asset Production with Video and Graphics Teams:** writes creative briefs, sets priorities and deadlines, and makes sure assets are ready ahead of publishing and events.
* **Manages Digital Social Contributors, VAs and the Coordinator:** recruits, trains, assigns work and holds the team accountable for output and quality.
* **Owns Performance Reporting and Leads Campaigns with Cross-Team Partners:** tracks and reports social metrics, uses the data to adjust strategy, and executes subscription and marketing campaigns with other departments.

**Must-Haves in a Candidate**

* **Social Media Mastery:** 2-3 years in social media strategy and execution for multi-brand or content-driven organization**s.**
* **Platform Fluency:** Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, and emerging platforms.
* **Creative & Analytical Balance:** Strong copywriting and creative instinct, paired with comfort in reading performance data to iterate.
* **Team Leadership:** Experience overseeing part-time social media contributors, freelancers, or agencies.
* **Brand Voice Stewardship:** Ability to craft and sustain a recognizable brand identity through content.
* **Collaboration:** Works seamlessly across departments — digital, video, graphics, events, and marketing.

**Nice-to-Haves in a Candidate**

* **Social Listening:** Proven ability to identify early platform trends and pivot content strategy quickly.
* **Multi-Brand Navigation:** Experience toggling between multiple voices or sub-brands without sacrificing consistency or clarity.
* **Tool Proficiency**: Knowledgeable in platforms such as Sprout Social (or a similar social media management tool), Asana, Google Workspace, and Slack.
* **Sports Industry Insight**: Brings experience or strong familiarity with youth athletics or sports media, enhancing relevance and brand alignment.
* **SEO & Social Search Knowledge:** Understands how social algorithms index content and can optimize titles, captions, keywords, and thumbnails for discovery.
* **Educational Background** – A Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

**Work Eligibility**

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. Only U.S. citizens will be considered for this role at this time.

**Benefits and Perks**  
At Prep Network, we take pride in our culture and commitment to creating an exceptional workplace environment. Here are some of the benefits and perks you can expect when you join our team:

* **Vibrant Culture**. Prep Network has been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for five years running, thanks to our vibrant and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about bringing on board curious, self-motivated individuals who work hard and genuinely enjoy their work.
* **Autonomy.** We trust our team members to excel in their roles. Rather than micromanaging, we provide you with the tools and processes needed for success, allowing you the freedom to bring your role to life and make a meaningful impact.
* **Professional Growth.** We prioritize your professional development. We actively support and encourage you to invest in your personal and professional growth.
* **Comprehensive Benefits.** We offer comprehensive health benefits, a 401(k) with Safe Harbor matching, long-term disability, and Basic Life Insurance. Work arrangements are flexible; whether you're in our Plymouth, MN office or working remotely

jobs.title: BASKETBALL SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER (Part-time, Remote)
jobs.description:
**CALLING THE BIGGEST BASKETBALL FAN OUT THERE**

Basketball Social Media Manager (Part-Time, Fully Remote)

**Job Type:** Part-Time  
**Location:** Fully Remote  
**Time Commitment:** Flexible, based on content needs and agreed-upon responsibilities  
**Compensation:** Hourly pay, based on experience and agreed upon before starting  
**Start Date:** ASAP

About The Role

We’re looking for someone who is **genuinely enthusiastic about basketball** and excited to help build and grow a basketball-focused social media page from the ground up.

The ideal candidate loves following the NBA, keeps up with news and trending storylines, and enjoys creating content that gets basketball fans talking. You should have a good sense of what makes content entertaining, shareable, and engaging on platforms like Instagram and Twitter (X).

This is an opportunity to turn your passion for basketball into a paid role, contribute creative ideas, and help develop a growing social media presence. The position is part-time and fully remote, with a relatively small daily time commitment.

**We’re looking to hire as soon as possible.**

Responsibilities

* Create and publish consistent basketball-related content across Instagram and Twitter (X).
* Develop engaging posts, short-form videos, commentary, memes, debates, and other content that resonates with basketball fans.
* Stay up to date on NBA news, games, players, trades, and trending basketball conversations.
* Identify timely topics and trends that could attract new followers and encourage engagement.
* Help develop the page’s voice, style, and overall content strategy.
* Engage authentically with the audience through comments, replies, and other relevant interactions.
* Monitor content performance and use engagement trends to improve future posts.
* Bring fresh ideas to the table and take initiative in helping grow the page.

Qualifications

* **Genuine enthusiasm for basketball** and a strong understanding of the NBA.
* Familiarity with Instagram, Twitter (X), and social media trends.
* Understanding of what makes basketball content entertaining, shareable, and engaging.
* Creativity and the ability to generate fresh content ideas.
* Reliability, consistency, and the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to learn, experiment, and adapt based on audience response.
* Experience using ChatGPT or Claude is a plus.
* Previous experience managing a social media page, creating sports content, or editing short-form videos is a plus, but not required.

Most importantly, we want someone who genuinely loves basketball, enjoys being part of the conversation, and is excited about building something. You don’t need to be an industry veteran, but you should be proactive, dependable, and willing to contribute ideas.

Schedule and Compensation

* Paid initial 30-day trial at an agreed hourly rate, at least the applicable New York minimum wage.
* Flexible scheduling, with work completed as needed to maintain consistent posting, timely basketball coverage, and audience engagement.
* Fully remote, with clear expectations around content quality, consistency, and communication.

At the end of the initial 30 days, we’ll review performance, discuss the experience, and determine whether it makes sense to continue working together.

For a successful long-term fit, there may be opportunities to discuss an ongoing hourly rate, performance-based bonuses, and additional compensation associated with future paid subscription offerings. Any future incentives would be discussed and agreed upon separately.

Who Would Be a Great Fit?

Someone who already spends time following basketball, enjoys discussing the game, notices trends, and naturally comes up with ideas for posts, videos, or debates. You might be a college student, an aspiring sports media creator, a social media enthusiast, or simply someone who loves basketball and wants to turn that interest into a paid opportunity.

If you’re passionate about basketball, creative, consistent, and excited about helping grow a basketball community, we’d love to hear from you.

**To apply:** Tell us a little about yourself, why you enjoy basketball, and any relevant social media or content creation experience. If you have examples of content you’ve created or pages you’ve managed, feel free to include them.

Pay: $1.00 - $2.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Social Media Marketing Manager - Remote
jobs.description:
Social Media Marketing Manager

  

DrHouse is a growing U.S. telehealth company seeking a hands-on, highly organized Social Media Marketing Manager to build and own social campaigns that drive awareness, website traffic, new patients, and use of our services.

You'll learn our business and audiences, bring campaign ideas, create content, manage engagement, and use performance data to improve results.

**Your performance will be measured on three outcomes: growth, meaningful engagement, and conversion.**

**What You'll Own**

* Channels: Manage Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Create B2B content for LinkedIn and consumer content for the other channels.
* Campaigns & calendar: Develop social campaigns tied to business priorities, seasonal moments, audience needs, and trends. Build and maintain a rolling 30-day content and campaign calendar.
* Content creation: Generate ideas and write hooks, captions, and post copy. Create everyday posts in Canva using templates, existing assets, carousels, user-generated content (UGC), and simple short-form video.
* UGC & creators: Help build our UGC and creator strategy, especially for TikTok and Instagram.
* Community engagement: Engage actively with relevant accounts, creators, communities, partners, and B2B audiences.
* Testing & reporting: Test ideas to increase reach, website traffic, and conversion. Track performance weekly, recommend what to scale, change, or stop, and flag top content for paid promotion.

  

**Creative Support**  
**You'll help set our social look and feel, including templates and content formats, and should be able to produce most everyday posts yourself in Canva. For advanced design, animation, or video editing, we may bring in additional creative support. You own the idea, direction, and day-to-day execution.**  
**Healthcare Context**

  

**You should understand, or be willing to quickly learn, healthcare marketing rules, including patient privacy (HIPAA), appropriate health claims, and when to escalate content or comments. Some content will need compliance review before publishing.**  
**What We're Looking For**  

* Proven experience growing social accounts with results beyond follower counts, and running campaigns from idea to results.
* Excellent written English and strong social copywriting skills.
* Strong Canva skills, good visual judgment, and short-form video experience.
* Highly organized and comfortable reading performance data.
* Creative, proactive, and able to work independently and with marketing and creative partners.

jobs.title: Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**
----------------

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

**How the funnel is shared**
----------------------------

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

**What this role is accountable for**
-------------------------------------

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid Media Strategy & Performance**

* Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
* Own budget pacing and allocation across all five ch

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do in This Role:  
Copy that moves people to act is rare, and this role produces it. You'll own the writing for a close-knit marketing squad that helps people find trusted experts who serve them well, crafting short-form pieces like emails, landing pages, paid ads, video scripts, and podcast promotions. You'll build campaigns alongside marketers, designers, and paid media specialists, test what works, and sharpen your craft with performance data. The work matters because the mission does: every message you write guides someone toward the right help at the right time.

You're Probably a Match If:

* Writing brand-aligned copy that captures Ramsey's voice, strikes the right emotion, and moves people to take the next step.

* Studying customer pain points, marketing journeys, and competitors so every project starts with a clear "why."

* Holding your work with an open hand, welcoming feedback, and carrying what you learn from one project to the next.
* Contributing to a squad culture of shared ownership by collaborating openly, engaging in healthy conflict, and showing up as a trusted teammate.

Other Stuff to Know:  
We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.

* Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads while reducing acquisition costs.

### **\*\*4. Marketing Reporting & Analytics**

\*\*

* Create and maintain weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Develop dashboards that provide visibility into advertising spend, lead generation, sales performance, and ROI.

\*\*

**\*\*What We're Looking For**

\*\*

We want someone who can do more than simply manage advertising accounts. We are looking for a digital marketer who understands how marketing impacts actual business revenue.

The right candidate will take ownership of our marketing channels, proactively identify growth opportunities, maintain accurate reporting, and consistently work toward generating more qualified leads and revenue for Rack Electric.

jobs.title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Camco Manufacturing:**
------------------------------

Camco Manufacturing, founded in 1966, has evolved from a humble beginning with one employee and a single product to become a powerhouse in the outdoor recreation market. With a rich history spanning over 50 years, Camco has grown exponentially, boasting a workforce of over 1,000 employees, 140+ patents, and an extensive product line exceeding 5,600 offerings.  
  
The company’s commitment to innovation is evident through its best-in-class, in-house development team, specializing in creating cutting-edge products for the RV, marine, ATV, and other outdoor recreation industries.  
  
Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, Camco operates eight separate manufacturing and warehousing facilities encompassing one million square feet. This extensive infrastructure allows Camco to efficiently meet the diverse needs of its customers, solidifying its position as a leading aftermarket parts and accessories manufacturer in the fast-growing outdoor recreation market.  
  
Focused on the RV, Marine, and Camping sectors, Camco’s influence in these industries is significant, as it continues to lead the charge with a relentless pursuit of excellence and a commitment to delivering top-notch products and services.  
  
Our products reach customers nationwide through partnerships with major retailers such as Walmart, Lowe’s, Amazon, and Camping World, alongside a growing network of dealers — giving our Ecommerce team a direct hand in how those products are discovered, purchased, and supported online.

**Location:** Greensboro, NC

**Position Type**: Marketing

**Overview:**
-------------

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Ecommerce Marketing Manager to lead Camco’s digital commerce efforts across our digital ecosystem including: corporate site experience, direct-to-consumer (D2C) strategy, dealer portal support, and product content management (PIM/DAM). This position is ideal for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution — establishing performance baselines, driving cross-functional projects, and scaling Camco’s ecommerce presence.  
  
This candidate will own the strategy and execution for CAMCO.net, dealer portal marketing support, D2C channel growth, and unified product data across ERP, PIM, and DAM systems, partnering closely with Marketing, IT and Sales to deliver measurable results. A strong analytical mindset, project management discipline, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives are key to success in this role.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own and execute Camco’s ecommerce strategy across four pillars: corporate site experience, D2C, dealer portal support, and content management (PIM/DAM)
* Conduct full audits of CAMCO.net, the dealer portal, and existing D2C activity to establish KPI baselines for sessions, bounce rate, conversion rate, and revenue
* Lead SEO strategy and execution to grow organic traffic and improve search rankings for priority product categories
* Build and maintain analytics dashboards to track ecommerce performance and report ROI to leadership
* Develop Camco’s direct-to-consumer (D2C) strategy, including consumer journey mapping, email/warranty-based data capture, and D2C revenue tracking
* Partner with the dealer network and internal teams to improve dealer portal self-service capabilities, including ordering, product lookup, account management, and warranty/claims support
* Support dealer marketing programs, including co-branded assets, seasonal campaigns, and new product alerts
* Lead product information and digital asset management (PIM/DAM) initiatives — auditing product data, closing content gaps, and coordinating with retail partners such as Amazon and Walmart on enriched product content
* Collaborate cross-functionally with IT, Sales, and Marketing to align data flows between ERP, PIM, DAM, and ecommerce/retailer channels
* Stay current on ecommerce, SEO, and digital commerce trends and the competitive landscape

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Ecommerce, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, or D2C strategy roles
* Proven experience with SEO, web analytics (Google Analytics), and building performance dashboards
* Experience with PIM/DAM platforms and product data management is a strong plus
* Familiarity with B2B dealer/distributor portals or B2B2C business models is a plus
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with IT, Sales, and Marketing stakeholders
* Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and reporting skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Compensation and Benefits:**
------------------------------

* We offer a wide range of career opportunities with excellent benefits. Above all, we are looking for passionate, talented, hard-working, nice people with great taste to help us build this brand we love.
* Competitive salary
* 401k with company match
* Participation in company health (medical, dental) insurance plans. Supplemental insurance offered
* Promote work/life balance including paid time off and paid holidays
* Flexible schedule options available

*Camco is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.*

**Details**

Our success is a direct reflection of the talented and diverse people who make a positive difference in the lives of our customers every day. The VP will oversee marketing budgets, agency and vendor relationships, and performance measurement, using customer, agent, market, and competitive insights to optimize marketing investments and drive measurable business results.

**About Bizzabo**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

  
Requirements:  
  

**What you'll do**

* Own positioning and messaging for the Event Experience OS. Translate new agentic capabilities into clear, provable value for enterprise event leaders, and keep the story consistent from the website to the last call before signature.
* Run launches end to end. Partner with Product on what we build and why, then own the go-to-market: narrative, pricing and packaging input, launch plan, field readiness, and customer communication.
* Help us win competitive deals. Own competitive intelligence against legacy event management platforms and newer point solutions. Build battlecards, landmine questions, and objection handling that reps actually use, and run win/loss analysis to sharpen them.
* Equip the field. Build the pitch narrative, demo storylines, one-pagers, and RFP content. Partner with Sales and Solutions leadership to train the team and make sure every new capability is sold, not just shipped.
* Lead analyst relations day to day. Own our Forrester and Gartner relationships, evaluation submissions, and briefings, plus our presence on peer review sites like G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.
* Turn customers into proof. Work with Account Management to build case studies, reference programs, and the metrics that make our claims specific.
* Drive adoption. Partner with Account Management to get existing customers using what we ship, through release communications, programs, and content for executive business reviews.
* Own the context layer. Our messaging, product, and competitive knowledge powers the Claude Skills our teams use to write, sell, and support. You'll keep that source of truth current and use AI to automate your own GTM workflows.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.
* You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.
* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.
* You've shipped your first launch end to end.

**Company Description**

**About M3:** A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

**M3 USA** is seeking a **Senior Manager, B2B Outbound Marketing** to develop and execute targeted outbound strategies across our portfolio of healthcare businesses.

You will work closely with sales and marketing leadership across multiple business units to develop buyer personas, build outreach campaigns using email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement platforms, and continuously optimize performance to drive measurable pipeline growth.

* Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients or brands with distinct customers.

* Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and hold a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

**The Company**

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

**The Role**

The Senior Demand Generation Manager is responsible for driving sustainable long-term pipeline growth and market engagement across Versaterm's portfolio of public safety solutions. This role leads high-complexity, cross-departmental initiatives through expertise and influence, and brings deep functional and technical mastery of demand generation. The Senior Demand Generation Manager frequently represents the marketing function in cross-departmental and external engagements, contributes directly to decisions that shape the direction of the area, mentors others, and actively champions Versaterm's values across the teams and work they influence.

**What You Do**

* Designs and plans targeted go-to-market programs to build brand awareness and generate and nurture leads through the sales and marketing funnel.
* Owns the strategy and execution of demand generation programs that drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth.
* Defines and develops new demand generation approaches, frameworks, and best practices that raise the standard across the function.
* Leverages digital platforms to automate marketing activities, including webinars, and determines the most effective points of interaction (POI) for marketing campaigns.
* Utilizes Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, customer information, and marketing automation platforms like Marketo and SFDC to create and deploy effective marketing campaigns.

Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a senior Growth leader to architect and operate our growth engine from the ground up — hands‑on. This isn't a "manage the agency" role. You'll be the one designing the system, wiring the stack, running the experiments, and shipping the assets. You think in funnels and frameworks, build measurement infrastructure before you launch campaigns, and treat go-to-market as an engineering discipline: instrument, test, iterate, scale.

You'll work directly with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand to turn signal into pipeline — and you'll be the one who actually builds the things that make that happen. Critically, you'll own the number: net new business in the form of marketing qualified leads is your north star, and you'll be accountable for hitting it. This will be a high-visibility role with incredible growth opportunities.

**What You'll Do**

**Ad Engine Ownership & Performance Marketing**

* Own the design, build, and continuous optimization of our ad engine across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and video — with a focus on efficiency, scale, and measurable pipeline contribution.
* Architect audience segmentation, bidding strategies, creative rotation logic, and budget allocation frameworks to maximize return on ad spend.
* Move beyond channel management: treat the ad engine as a product, iterating on targeting logic, landing page pairings, offer variants, and conversion pathways to compound performance over time.
* Own hands‑on execution — you're in the platforms, not just reviewing reports.

**Driving Net New Business: MQL Ownership**

* Own the MQL number. You are directly accountable for generating net new marketing qualified leads that convert into pipeline and revenue.
* Build and operate the demand generation engine that fills the top of funnel — from first touch to sales-ready hand‑off — with clear SLAs, routing logic, and feedback loops.
* Define and enforce MQL quality standards in partnership with Sales and RevOps, continuously tightening the criteria as signal improves.
* Report on MQL volume, velocity, cost-per-MQL, and downstream conversion rates; use those inputs to direct investment across channels and programs.

**Scaling the Marketing Foundation: 1 to 100**

* Take the marketing foundations already in place — brand narrative, positioning, early channel presence, initial playbooks — and build the operational engine that scales them.
* Translate strategy into a repeatable growth system: standardized processes, campaign architecture, channel playbooks, and asset libraries that multiply output without multiplying headcount.
* Identify what's working at small scale and build the infrastructure — tooling, measurement, creative, ops — to run it at 10x without losing fidelity or efficiency.
* Close the gaps between brand and demand: ensure every scaled program reinforces positioning while driving measurable business outcomes.

**Full-Funnel Growth System Ownership**

* Design and own the full‑funnel growth architecture: paid (search, social, programmatic, video), organic (SEO, content, web), ABM, partnerships, and referral.
* Build the experimentation infrastructure — test frameworks, audience segmentation, offer variants, landing page scaffolding — and run rapid learning cycles.
* Engineer the demand‑to‑pipeline path: ICP definitions, routing logic, handoff SLAs, and Sales feedback loops.
* Identify new channels and build the playbook before you scale spend.

**Growth Stack & Analytics**

* Instrument the growth funnel end‑to‑end across Salesforce, HubSpot, GA4, Webflow/CMS, and attribution/BI tooling.
* Partner with RevOps and Analytics to establish taxonomy, data hygiene standards, experimentation frameworks, and attribution models that hold up under scrutiny.
* Build dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make the "what's working" question answerable in real time — and translate results into insights, next actions, and investment guidance for Marketing and GTM leaders.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Serve as the DRI for growth: set strategy, run the operating cadence, and align Sales, RevOps, Product, and Brand around clear priorities and decision criteria.
* Build influence without line authority — turn cross‑functional stakeholders into an integrated growth squad.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap and experiment backlog; communicate trade‑offs and learnings frequently.

**What You Have**

* Senior, hands‑on experience building integrated growth programs in B2B SaaS; healthtech experience a plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of an MQL or pipeline number

The Marketing Manager (Partner Marketing) accelerates Corporate and Legal Compliance’s (CLC) growth by generating demand with and through strategic partners, including resellers, referral partners, and complementary providers. The role serves as the dedicated marketing owner for the CLC partnership channel, translating partnership strategy into joint go-to-market plans, co-marketing campaigns, partner enablement, and measurable commercial outcomes.

This position owns the Partner marketing plan, program budget, campaign calendar, and performance reporting. It works closely with Partnership Operations, segment marketing, product marketing, digital marketing, sales, creative teams, shared services, and agencies to ensure partners can effectively sell to, sell through, and sell with CLC while maintaining consistency with direct-to-customer messaging.

  

**Essential Duties and** **Responsibilities**

**Partner Marketing Strategy and Planning**

* Own the annual and quarterly partner marketing strategy, portfolio plan, campaign calendar, and program budget aligned to the indirect go-to-market strategy and CLC growth priorities.
* Apply business and financial acumen in partner conversations to build relationships with marketing leaders at select partner accounts.
* Assess partner opportunities and recommend right-sized marketing approaches based on partner model, audience, commercial potential, readiness, and available resources.
* Create joint marketing plans with priority partners, defining target audiences, value propositions, tactics, responsibilities, timelines, investment requirements, and success measures.
* Segment partners by type, maturity, solution area, commercial potential, and readiness, and define differentiated engagement and enablement paths for each segment.
Partner with Partnership team to support partner onboarding, quarterly planning, and ongoing growth opportunities.  

  

**Co-Marketing Campaigns and Demand Generation**

* Plan, develop, and execute integrated co-marketing programs that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced leads, pipeline, cart sales, revenue, and share-of-wallet expansion.
* Lead partner marketing activities such as webinars, events, email programs, digital campaigns, marketplace or listing presence, launch support, referral programs, and partner promotions.
* Orchestrate campaign delivery across internal shared services, creative resources, marketing operations, digital teams, and external agencies.
Ensure campaigns include clear objectives, audience definitions, calls to action, tracking requirements, lead follow-up processes, and optimization plans.  

  

**Partner Enablement and Content**

* Develop scalable partner enablement materials, including pitch decks, one-sheets, sales kits, landing pages, website copy, email and newsletter content, webinar materials, product launch kits, and trade-show assets.
* Create reusable toolkits that allow partners to promote CLC offerings consistently and efficiently.

Work with internal and external creative resources to deliver high-quality, brand-compliant materials.

Coordinate with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Legal, Finance, and Partner Success to confirm partners have approved positioning, training, sales materials, contractual and legal resources, pricing guidance, support processes, and escalation paths before launch.  

  

**Performance Measurement and Optimization**

* Own the plan and process for measuring partner marketing outcomes and return on marketing investment.
* Define and report performance across campaign engagement, partner-sourced and partner-influenced leads, opportunities, pipeline, revenue, cart sales, cross-sell or upsell, and enablement adoption.
* Partner with Rev Operations to support lead-to-revenue tracking for indirect routes to market and establish reliable campaign and attribution practices.
* Provide executive-ready partner insights that identify engagement levels, opportunity generation, adoption and enablement gaps, programs driving measurable outcomes, and recommendations for scaling successful partner motions or correcting underperformance.
Use performance insights to optimize campaigns, recommend investment shifts, and communicate results to marketing and partnership leadership.  

**Key Deliverables**

* Partner marketing portfolio plan aligned to the indirect go-to-market strategy
* Annual and quarterly partner marketing campaign and tactic calendar
* Joint marketing plans and partner launch plans
* Partner enablement toolkits and co-branded campaign assets
* Lead-to-revenue pro

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

At HackerOne, great content starts with a great story. It’s how we make complex cybersecurity topics understandable, turn original research into insights people remember, and build trust with security leaders.

As our Content Marketing Manager, you’ll help find and tell those stories. You’ll lead key parts of our content program, including the HackerOne blog, annual research, search optimization, and editorial standards. You’ll work with experts across HackerOne to uncover interesting ideas, find the story in the data, and turn technical expertise into content that is clear, useful, and worth reading.

This role is part editor, part storyteller, and part content strategist. You’ll bring strong editorial judgment, curiosity, and an audience-first mindset to what we create, while using data, search insights, and AI tools to help our content reach the right people and make a measurable impact.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Manage the HackerOne blog, including the editorial calendar, story development, publishing, optimization, and performance tracking.
* Lead the development of HackerOne’s annual research and flagship reports, finding the strongest stories in our data and working with internal experts and partners to turn those insights into compelling narratives.
* Find stories across HackerOne by interviewing subject matter experts, asking the right questions, and identifying perspectives that can strengthen our thought leadership.
* Turn complex cybersecurity topics into clear, engaging content for security leaders without losing the substance or expertise behind them.
* Help execute our answer engine optimization (AEO) and search engine optimization (SEO) strategy, using search data and audience insights to identify opportunities and improve content performance.
* Maintain and apply HackerOne’s Style Guide to ensure our content is clear, consistent, and distinctly HackerOne.
* Manage the content intake process, helping teams sharpen ideas, prioritize requests, and move strong stories from concept to publication.
* Multiply the impact of our best stories by adapting content for campaigns, social media, and audience engagement.
* Measure content performance and use those insights to understand what resonates with our audience and inform what we create next.
* Use AI tools throughout the content process to support research, idea development, drafting, editing, optimization, and repurposing while maintaining strong human editorial judgment.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, or a related role.
* A strong storyteller with demonstrated experience finding an interesting angle, building a clear narrative, and making complex subjects engaging and accessible.
* Excellent writing, editing, and interviewing skills, with strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.
* Experience developing research-driven content, reports, or thought leadership and turning data and expert insights into stories for a specific audience.
* Experience managing a content program, publication, or editorial calendar.
* Experience with SEO and/or AEO, including keyword research, content optimization, and performance measurement.
* Experience using AI tools to support content creation, research, optimization, or other marketing workflows.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across teams and bring ideas from concept to publication.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience creating content for B2B technology, cybersecurity, or another technical industry.
* A background in journalism, editorial, research, or another field where interviewing and story development are core skills.
* Familiarity with content and search performance tools such as Google Analytics, SEMrush, or similar tools.
* Experience adapting stories and content for social media and other marketing channels.
* Experience partnering with product marketing, demand generation, communications, or product teams.

KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.

Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

**Why This Role Exists**

Automotive retail is consolidating, and the groups leading it are choosing the partners they'll run on for the next decade. More of their research now starts inside AI answer engines, and KPA's growth is concentrated in those multi-rooftop groups and in clients who already trust us adding coverage. That calls for a deliberate growth model, not a busier campaign calendar.

This role sets that model. You'd own the vision and strategy for demand generation across the company: the go-to-market model Marketing, Sales, and Client Success run together, the playbook behind it, the plan and investment case for the pipeline number, and the multi-year build-out of the team, technology, and measurement that will carry it at scale. While the team help you run the engine, you decide what it's built to do, where it points, and how big it gets.

*If you've built a demand function before and want to design the next one from the model up, with the mandate to make it the way the whole company grows, this is it.*

**The Role**

The Director, Demand Generation owns KPA's demand strategy and marketing's contribution to lead pipeline and revenue. You report to the Chief Marketing Officer, sit on the marketing leadership team, and lead the demand team and its agency partners.

The mandate runs in order: make the funnel measurable, make the engine repeatable, then scale it. The team is lean, so you'll definitely be hands-on and in the trenches, and will stay close enough to the work to pressure-test it. But your leverage is the model, the people, and the decisions.

Success is measured in pipeline against the company plan, a funnel all commercial functions trust, and an engine that gets more efficient as it grows, with a clear answer to where the next dollar goes and where we should be consistently testing and learning.

**What You'll Do**

**Set the Vision and the Go-to-Market Model**

* Define KPA's demand generation vision and multi-year strategy, and turn it into an annual plan the company aligns to: targets, budget, channel mix, and capacity.
* Design the go-to-market model by segment: single-rooftop dealers, multi-rooftop groups, fleet and adjacent segments; new logo, account-based, and expansion. Decide which plays each gets and what each should return.
* Own the demand playbook as a company standard: the plays, the stage definitions, and the handoffs and service levels between Marketing and Sales (and Client Success). Codify it so it outlasts the current team.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product so every launch has a pipeline plan, not just an announcement.

**Own the Pipeline Number and the Investment Case**

* Own marketing's sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue targets and the forecast behind them. Report against them candidly - including when the number is short.
* Own the demand budget and make the case for it: reverse-funnel models, scenarios, and a defensible return on every line across channels, agencies, events, and technology.
* Represent marketing performance to the executive team and the board with numbers that hold up under questioning.

**Set the Measurement Standard**

* Decide KPA's funnel definitions (lead, MQL, SAL, SQL, opportunity) and attribution approach with Revenue Operations and Sales, align the organization, and hold every team to them.
* Move KPA from counting engagements to counting true net-new demand, and be candid with leadership about what changes when the denominator does.
* Define the reporting the business runs on (pipeline, velocity, CAC, CPL, and payback by segment, motion, and program) and the roadmap to a proper BI layer.

**Build the Engine to Scale**

* Write the multi-year build-out plan: team structure and hiring sequence, what we build in-house versus buy from agencies, and the order in which new capabilities are deployed.
* Set the marketing technology roadmap with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations: what the stack must do at twice our size, what we consolidate, and what we retire.
* Set the operating model for AI in demand gen, including where it helps compound output, where a person stays in the loop, and guardrails on accuracy, claims, brand voice, and data handling that a compliance company can defend.

**Lead the Account-Based and Expansion Strategy**

* Set the strategy for the multi-rooftop groups consolidating the market: tiering, named-account coverage with Sales, and one coordinated marketing and SDR motion against each account.
* Build the expansion strategy with Sales and Client Success. Growing coverage among the more than 15,000 clients who already trust KPA is the largest near-term growth lever we have.

**Lead the Team and the Partnerships**

* Lead weekly status calls, monthly business reviews, and quarterly strategy sessions

* Develop and execute account-level strategies focused on revenue growth, profitability, and long-term brand positioning

**Performance Tracking and Analysis**

* Monitor KPIs including revenue, sessions, conversion rate, Buy Box percentage, etc.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities early and take proactive action
* Use Amazon reporting and internal analytics to evaluate performance drivers
* Translate data into insights that inform both short-term and long-term actions

**Operations and Issue Resolution**

About The Wells Michael Collective

The Wells Michael Collective is an independent luxury real estate brokerage in Ladue, Missouri, led by partners Justin Michael and Suzie Wells. We represent significant homes across St. Louis and present them through architecture, design and the lives lived inside them.

The role

You will be the creative voice of The Wells Michael Collective across every screen and every printed page. You will own our social presence from concept to camera to caption, build the content strategy behind it, and design the brochures, mailers and campaigns that put our homes and our people in front of the right audience.

You will sit at the table with both partners and shape how the brand looks and sounds as it grows. Your ideas will move from sketch to published within days, with no agency layers or committee approvals in between. This is an in office and in field position, split between our Ladue office and shoots, listings and events across St. Louis.

What you will own

**Social media production and publishing**

* Plan, shoot, edit and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube
* Produce short form video, reels and stories for every listing, from Coming Soon through Sold
* Direct photographers and videographers on set so every shoot matches the brand
* Write captions with an editorial voice: precise, warm and free of real estate clichés
* Manage the posting calendar, community replies and direct messages

**Content strategy**

* Build and run a monthly content strategy tied to listings, market moments, advisors and the St. Louis lifestyle
* Track performance every month and turn the numbers into next month's plan
* Develop recurring series that give people a reason to follow us: home stories, architecture, neighborhoods, design
* Grow audience quality as well as audience size, with the goal of reaching the clients who buy and sell significant homes

**Brand design**

* Design listing collateral in Canva: brochures, feature sheets, postcards, mailers and presentation pieces
* Keep every asset on brand using our Canva Brand Kit, palette and typography
* Prepare print files with correct bleed and specs for our print partners
* Build InDesign layouts for longer editorial pieces as the brand expands

**Brand expansion**

* Launch new advisors with a polished public profile and content plan
* Support press, magazine ads, events and community partnerships
* Help build the visual playbook that will carry the brand into new markets

What you bring

**Required**

* 3+ years producing social content and design work for a brand, ideally in luxury, hospitality, fashion, design or real estate
* Advanced Canva skills, with a portfolio that proves it
* An eye for elevation: you know the difference between expensive and significant, and your work shows restraint
* Strong photo and video skills on a phone and in an editing app such as CapCut, Premiere Rush or Lightroom
* Clear, polished writing with a natural editorial voice
* Comfort with analytics on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
* Organized, self directed and able to run a calendar with many moving parts
* Based in St. Louis and able to be on site at shoots, events and the Ladue office

**A plus**

* Adobe InDesign, Photoshop or Illustrator
* Experience with print production and working with print vendors
* Experience directing photographers, videographers or stylists
* A following or portfolio built around architecture, interiors or St. Louis

Please include a portfolio. We hire on the strength of the work.

Growth path

This role is designed to grow into the head of marketing as the company grows. The path is tied to results, and you will review progress with both partners every quarter.

* **Marketing & Brand Content Manager.** Own social, content strategy and listing design. Build the systems and the calendar.
* **Senior Brand Manager.** Lead campaigns, press and partnerships. Manage freelance photographers, videographers and designers.
* **Director of Marketing & Brand.** Lead a marketing team, own the brand budget and guide the brand into new markets.

You will also receive an annual professional development budget for courses, conferences and creative tools, plus direct mentorship from two partners who have built a luxury brand from the ground up.

Compensation, bonus and benefits

* **Base salary:** based on experience and portfolio
* **Annual bonus:** tied to company growth milestones you helped drive
* **Paid time off:** PTO and major holidays, with a quiet week between Christmas and New Year's
* **Professional development:** an annual budget for courses, conferences and creative tools
* **Your tools (provided by the company):** a laptop, Canva Pro, Adobe Creative Cloud and the gear you need to shoot
* **Access:** a front row seat inside some of the most significant homes in St. Louis, and direct connection to the clients, designers, architects, builders and community leaders who shape them, with real networking opportunities through our events and partnerships

Send your resume, a portfolio link and three pieces of work you are proudest of to team@wellsmichael.com. Tell us in a few sentences what you would change first about our Instagram. We read every application, and finalists will complete a short paid creative exercise.

Pay: From $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Brand Specialist is a self-starter that keeps projects on track and on time within LifeStraw’s marketing department. This is a generalist, execution-focused role: you own the intake system, the project tracker, and contribute to building out new campaign assets and sales enablement materials. In addition to being a core contributor on the marketing team, you also serve as the primary point-of-contact to sales. You are the glue; you help the two teams stay aligned and ensure sales requests are actioned appropriately in the marketing project pipeline.

You'll report to the Senior Brand Manager and work daily with Creative, Content & Social, and the Sales team across Outdoor, Retail, Amazon, International, and Institutional channels.

**What You Own**

* **Marketing Execution**

* Develop and repurpose high-quality campaign content, including blog posts, website content, email campaigns, and social media

* Assist in running surveys to collect consumer feedback and producing an analysis of findings
* Support a regular cadence of marketing reporting to share performance data internally with key stakeholders

* Produce light graphic design in Canva, including social media graphics, email banners, event promotions, infographics, and branded collateral

* **Project Management & Request Intake (Asana)**

* Own the Asana workspace: project templates, task structure, custom fields, due dates, dashboards, and user onboarding.
* Own the shared marketing request tracker and the master marketing and sales calendar in Asana: launches, campaigns, promos, retail resets, and trade shows.
* Own the marketing request intake form and triage queue. Route every incoming request from Sales, Ecommerce, and internal stakeholders to the right owner with a due date attached and confirm receipt to the requester.
* Check every creative brief for completeness before it reaches Creative. Chase the missing information down yourself rather than passing an incomplete brief along.
* Serve as the intake gatekeeper for ad-hoc or under-briefed requests, ensuring they follow the intake process before reaching Creative.
* Maintain and enforce SOPs for creative briefs, timelines, approval workflows, and file handoff.
* Run the weekly cross-functional sync with Sales and Marketing: agenda, notes, action items, follow-up.

* **Digital Asset Management (Bynder)**

* Own our Bynder DAM end to end uploads, naming conventions, metadata tagging, collections, and user permissions.
* Serve as the first responder on all asset requests from Sales, Ecommerce, retail partners, PR, and creators.
* Process new creative into the DAM once approved, correctly tagged by product, channel, and campaign, so the right file is easy to find.
* Track asset usage rights and expirations (talent, photography, licensed imagery) and flag anything approaching expiry to the Sr. Brand Manager.
* Build and share curated collections and links for retail partners, distributors, and press, and retire outdated assets so the wrong pack shot never ships.

* **Sales Enablement Library**

* Own the sell sheet, sales catalogue, one-pager, and trade show materials library, keeping it current and organized by channel.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Brand Manager to ensure launch kits include all sales-facing deliverables on schedule.
* Track which materials each Sales channel is using and flag gaps.

*Day-to-day support work where you execute against direction set by the Sr. Brand Manager and channel leads.*

* **Social publishing support:** Assist with scheduling organic social posts to the content calendar, load captions and assets, and compile weekly engagement reporting.
