You compile and maintain accurately and on time; the Sr. Brand Manager and VP set direction and interpret strategic implications.

* **Sample & seeding coordination:** Coordinate product samples and seeding shipments for press, creators, and Sales, and keep the tracking log current.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Pallas Textiles
jobs.description:
At KI, we believe knowing our customers helps us serve them better. We listen. We observe. We understand that each customer has unique needs. So, we pride ourselves on helping our customers make smart furniture decisions by offering expert advice, design options and personalized solutions. Since 1941, we’ve positioned KI as the furniture company that best understands the furniture industry and is committed to providing customers with the smart solutions. By targeting specific markets with solutions for business furniture, university furniture, educational furniture, healthcare furniture and government furniture, we can quickly respond to our customers’ unique needs – including the choice to procure furniture according to what fits their ordering and fulfillment process. That’s why we say we offer far more than furniture. We’re Furnishing Knowledge.
  
  
Job Overview
  
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Brand Manager for our Pallas Textiles division who will work from KI’s Corporate Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin. This position is responsible for shaping and elevating the Pallas brand through strategic marketing, compelling storytelling, and innovative product positioning. This role develops and executes integrated marketing initiatives that bring textile collections to life, translating design inspiration, color stories, and brand vision into meaningful customer experiences. Working closely with the VP of Pallas, design, sales, and cross-functional teams, the Brand Manager drives brand strategy, product launches, portfolio positioning, and marketing campaigns that strengthen brand awareness, support business growth, and deepen engagement within the commercial design community. The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and creative marketer who thrives at the intersection of design, branding, and relationship-driven collaboration.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that bring the Pallas brand and collections to life through compelling storytelling, visual content, and customer experiences.
* Lead the creation of marketing campaigns, product launches, and content strategies across digital, print, social, and industry channels.
* Partner closely with designers to translate collection inspiration, color stories, and creative vision into impactful market positioning and brand narratives.
* Drive the development of product imagery, catalogs, sales tools, and branded marketing materials that support customer engagement and sales growth.
* Own and evolve the Pallas brand strategy, ensuring a consistent and distinctive brand presence across all customer touchpoints.
* Collaborate with sales, leadership, operations, and external partners to align marketing initiatives with business objectives and product launches.
* Transform customer, sales, and market insights into compelling product positioning and portfolio strategies that strengthen market relevance.
* Lead major brand initiatives from concept through execution, managing timelines, priorities, resources, and deliverables.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and emerging design influences to identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and continuously refine strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and market impact.

What you Need to Succeed
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field.
* 5-7 year’ experience in marketing, brand management or related role, preferably in the design/creative industry.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies that drive business growth.
* Strong leadership and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Creative thinker with a keen eye for design and detail.
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools, content management systems, graphic design software, and analytics platforms.

What KI Offers You
  

* Participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): As an employee, you will have stock ownership in the company.
* Competitive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for your well-being.
* A 401(k) Plan with Company Match: A retirement savings plan with employer contributions.
* Paid Vacation, Sick Days, & Holidays: Time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones.
* Wellness Resources: Access to an on-site fitness center, fitness reimbursement program, and on-site nurse.
* Onsite Cafe: Enjoy a full breakfast and lunch menu right at work.
* Employee Product Discounts: Special pricing on company products.
* Educational Reimbursement Program: Support for degree programs and certifications.
* Full Benefits Package: Includes life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Apply today!
  
  
KI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Co-Dough | Newport, RI**  
**Full-Time | Hybrid**

Co-Dough is looking for an experienced and highly creative **Social Media & Brand Marketing Manager** to oversee our social media channels, create high-quality original content, and support our broader marketing efforts.

This is a hands-on role for someone with strong creative judgment, an exceptional eye for content, and the organization and experience to take projects from concept through execution.

### **Responsibilities**

**Social Media & Content**

* Manage Co-Dough’s day-to-day social media accounts
* Plan, create, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms
* Develop and maintain an organized content calendar
* Capture and edit high-quality photo and video content
* Create Reels, TikToks, Stories, and other short-form content
* Write captions and social copy consistent with Co-Dough’s brand voice
* Manage comments, messages, tags, and community engagement
* Monitor social media performance and analytics
* Maintain an organized library of photo and video assets
* Stay current on relevant social media trends and platform updates

**Marketing & Brand**

* Develop and present creative marketing ideas
* Plan and execute approved marketing initiatives
* Support consistency across customer-facing brand materials
* Assist with additional marketing and creative projects as needed

This is an experienced-level position. Candidates must have demonstrated professional experience managing social media and creating content for a brand, business, or professional client.

* 2+ years of relevant professional experience
* Demonstrated experience directly managing brand or business social media accounts
* Strong portfolio of professional social media, photography, video, or marketing work
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and short-form content
* Strong photography, filming, and editing skills
* Experience developing and managing content calendars
* Excellent writing and copywriting skills
* Understanding of social media analytics
* Strong creative and visual judgment
* Understanding of brand voice and visual consistency
* Experience with content creation and editing tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar
* Strong organizational and project-management skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* High attention to detail and a high standard for finished work
* Comfortable receiving creative direction and feedback
* Reliable, proactive, and able to follow through

A college degree is not required. Professional experience, creative ability, judgment, and quality of work are more important to us than a specific degree.

The ability to understand and execute Co-Dough’s brand voice and creative direction is essential to this position. You’ll work closely with the founder on creative direction while independently managing the day-to-day responsibilities of the role. All outward-facing content and marketing materials are subject to final approval.

### **Schedule**

* Full-time
* Hybrid, with regular in-person hours required at Co-Dough
* Occasional weekend or evening availability may be required

Please submit:

* Resume
* Portfolio or examples of professional work
* Links to brand or business social media accounts you have directly managed
* A brief introduction

**A portfolio or examples of previous professional work are required for consideration.**

**Compensation:** Salary based on experience

jobs.description:
About InSeng Taekwondo

InSeng Taekwondo is a premier Olympic-style Taekwondo school located in downtown Boulder, Colorado. Led by world-class instructors with Olympic and USA National Team coaching experience, we offer high-quality training for beginners, recreational students, and competitive athletes.

Our mission extends beyond martial arts. We believe in developing confident, disciplined, and resilient individuals who become leaders both inside and outside the ring.

In addition to our local programs, we actively participate in and host Taekwondo competitions, seminars, and training events throughout the United States.

We're looking for a creative, motivated individual to help share our story, grow our online presence, and introduce more people to our community.

About the Role

We're seeking a part-time Social Media & Marketing Coordinator to manage our social media presence, create engaging content, and support the growth of our school.

At a minimum, we're looking for someone who can visit our studio a few times per month to capture high-quality photos and videos, create engaging Instagram and Facebook content, and maintain a consistent social media presence.

For candidates with additional experience, this role offers the opportunity to take ownership of broader marketing initiatives, including lead generation, brand development, event promotion, and membership growth.

**We're open to candidates at different experience levels**, from talented student content creators to experienced marketing professionals.

Core Responsibilities — Social Media & Content Creation

* Visit our Boulder studio approximately 2–4 times per month to capture photos and videos of classes, training sessions, athletes, and events.
* Create engaging short-form videos, including Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other video content.
* Manage content creation, scheduling, and publishing across Instagram and Facebook, with opportunities to expand to additional platforms.
* Capture compelling moments that showcase our athletes, instructors, training environment, and community.
* Edit photos and videos into polished, engaging content that reflects our brand.
* Develop creative content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule.
* Create a balance of athlete highlights, training content, community stories, and promotional material.
* Help maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across our social media channels.
* Monitor social media performance and recommend opportunities to improve engagement and reach.

Travel & Event Coverage Opportunities

InSeng Taekwondo participates in and hosts competitions, training camps, and special events throughout the United States.

Depending on interest, availability, and experience, this position may include opportunities to travel with our team to:

* Capture photography and videography at national and regional Taekwondo competitions.
* Produce behind-the-scenes content featuring athletes, coaches, and tournament experiences.
* Create event recap videos, athlete highlights, and social media coverage.
* Help promote and document tournaments, seminars, and special training events.
* Gain hands-on experience with live sports content production and event marketing.

**Travel is not required for the core position**, but opportunities may be available for candidates interested in sports media, event production, and athletics.

Approved business travel expenses will be covered by InSeng Taekwondo, with compensation and travel arrangements discussed in advance.

Additional Opportunities — Marketing & Business Growth

For candidates with stronger marketing or business development experience, responsibilities may also include:

**Lead Generation & Membership Growth**

* Develop social media campaigns to attract prospective students and families.
* Create strategies that convert social media engagement into trial class bookings and new memberships.
* Assist with responding to and following up with prospective members.
* Track inquiries, trial bookings, and marketing conversions.
* Develop and manage paid advertising campaigns through Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, and other platforms.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.

**Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies for InSeng Taekwondo.
* Strengthen our brand identity and messaging across online and offline channels.
* Create promotional campaigns for programs, tournaments, training camps, and community events.
* Design or coordinate flyers, advertisements, and other promotional materials.
* Identify opportunities for local partnerships, community outreach, and cross-promotions.
* Help grow awareness of our school and its programs within Boulder and surrounding communities.
* Develop marketing initiatives that support membership growth and event participation.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Experience creating engaging social media content through professional, personal, or academic projects.
* Ability to capture quality photos and videos using a smartphone or camera.
* Familiarity with Instagram and Facebook content formats, including Reels, Stories, and feed posts.
* Experience editing short-form videos.
* Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar tools.
* Strong communication, creativity, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Availability to visit our Boulder studio several times per month.

**Preferred, but Not Required**

* Experience managing social media accounts for businesses or organizations.
* Photography, videography, or graphic design experience.
* Experience covering sporting events or producing athlete-focused content.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, paid social media advertising, or SEO.
* Experience with lead generation, customer relationship management, or marketing analytics.
* Experience developing marketing campaigns or brand strategies.
* Interest in fitness, athletics

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Type: [Full-Time]**

**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and creative Marketing Coordinator to join our team. This individual will oversee the development and execution of marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility and drive customer engagement. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the culinary industry. Additionally, the Marketing Coordinator will take on creative director responsibilities, guiding the overall visual and thematic direction of marketing materials and content.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Strategic Planning**

* **Market Research**: Analyze industry trends, customer preferences, and competitor strategies. Conduct surveys or focus groups to gather insights.
* **Target Audience Identification**: Define customer personas based on demographics, psychographics, and dining behaviors.
* **Marketing Goals**: Establish short-term and long-term marketing objectives (e.g., increase brand awareness, boost sales by X%, launch a new menu).

**2. Brand Management**

* **Brand Development**: Ensure brand consistency across all restaurant locations. Create brand guidelines for logos, colors, and tone of voice.
* **Reputation Management**: Monitor online reviews and social media presence. Engage with customers and address their concerns promptly.

**3. Digital Marketing**

* **Website Management**: Optimize the restaurant group’s website for user experience and SEO. Ensure menus, locations, and promotions are updated.
* **Social Media Strategy**: Develop a content calendar for platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Post engaging content, including behind-the-scenes, promotions, and user-generated content.
* **Email Marketing**: Create newsletters to inform customers about upcoming events, new dishes, and special offers. Segment the audience for personalized campaigns.

**4. Content Creation**

* **Visual and Written Content**: Produce high-quality content for various platforms, including blog posts, social media updates, videos, and promotional materials. Ensure all content aligns with brand voice and strategy.
* **Creative Development**: Lead the creative direction for marketing materials, including ad videos and detailed flyers. Collaborate with designers, videographers, and copywriters to create compelling content that resonates with the target audience.

**5. Promotional Campaigns**

* **Seasonal Promotions**: Plan and execute seasonal campaigns (e.g., holiday specials, summer menus). Collaborate with chefs to create unique offerings.
* **Loyalty Programs**: Develop a loyalty program to encourage repeat business. Use customer data to tailor rewards and promotions.
* **Events and Collaborations**: Organize events, such as tastings, cooking classes, or partnerships with local businesses (e.g., breweries, farms).

**6. Advertising**

* **Media Planning**: Identify appropriate channels for advertising (online, print, radio). Allocate budget effectively.
* **Creative Development**: Oversee the production of compelling ads that resonate with the target audience, ensuring alignment with overall marketing strategy.

**7. Analytics and Reporting**

* **Performance Metrics**: Track KPIs such as customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value, and social media engagement.
* **Regular Reporting**: Prepare monthly/quarterly reports on marketing performance. Analyze what worked and what didn’t and adjust strategies accordingly.

**8. Collaboration and Team Management**

* **Cross-Department Collaboration**: Work closely with the culinary team to ensure promotions align with menu offerings. Collaborate with operations to maintain service quality during promotional periods.

**Example Campaign Ideas**

* **“Taste of the Month”**: Feature a different dish each month, highlighting local ingredients.
* **Social Media Challenges**: Encourage customers to post their dining experiences with a specific hashtag for a chance to win a gift card.
* **Community Involvement**: Partner with local charities for fundraising events, offering a percentage of sales on specific days.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Employee discounts at restaurant locations

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Gow School, a nationally recognized leader in educating students with dyslexia and other language-based learning differences, seeks a dynamic Director of Marketing and Communications to lead and elevate the school’s storytelling, brand, and strategic communications efforts.

Founded in 1926, Gow is a college-preparatory boarding and day school serving students in grades 5–12 and postgraduate learners. Through small classes, expert faculty, and a deeply supportive community, Gow helps students build confidence, independence, and lifelong success.

Reporting to the Head of School and serving as a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Marketing and Communications is responsible for strengthening The Gow School's visibility, generating prospective student leads, and supporting enrollment growth through effective marketing and communications.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring a highly motivated, independent professional who can develop strategies and execute them. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who takes ownership of projects, manages competing priorities, anticipates marketing and communication needs, meets deadlines, and produces high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

The Director must be comfortable managing social media independently, overseeing the School's website and search engine optimization (SEO), developing digital marketing and drip campaigns, and using data to evaluate and report results.

Working closely with Enrollment Management, Finance, and our Board of Trustees, the Director will ensure marketing efforts support the School's enrollment goals, financial priorities, and overall mission.

**Key Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Hai Hospitality is accepting applications for an experienced **Director of Growth and Digital Marketing** for our Home Office based in Austin, TX. We are an innovative and growing restaurant group, looking for individuals who are creative, ambitious, and passionate about food and people.

  
  

The Director of Growth and Digital Marketing leads measurable guest and revenue growth across Hai Hospitality’s multi-brand, multi-market portfolio. This role owns the growth strategy and performance of paid media, digital discovery, brand websites, online conversion, and marketing activity across third-party ordering platforms. The Director also leads the CRM, lifecycle, and loyalty function through agency support with the future to bring function in-house, connecting acquisition with repeat visits and guest value. This leader turns brand and business priorities into coordinated digital plans, builds clear measurement, and partners closely with Brand Management, Social, Creative Services, Operations, Finance, and agency partners.

  

Reports Directly to: Chief Brand Officer

  

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Growth Strategy and Performance Marketing**

* Set the portfolio growth and digital marketing roadmap, translating annual brand plans, market priorities, and openings into measurable channel plans.

* Own paid and performance media strategy, budget allocation, agency/vendor direction, channel mix, audience strategy, testing, and optimization across search, paid social, and relevant platforms.

* Partner with the Head of Social and Content on creative inputs and trafficking for paid campaigns; Growth owns media investment, targeting, placements, testing, and results.

* Build a testing culture that improves incremental revenue, guest acquisition, conversion, return on ad spend, and cost efficiency; distinguish channel attribution from business incrementality where data allows.
  

**Web, search, and digital guest experience**

* Own the portfolio website roadmap and ongoing web redesign, new web launches, and ongoing management, including vendor direction, content publishing workflows, technical health, UX, accessibility, conversion, and online-ordering pathways.

* Lead SEO and local digital discovery strategy, including location pages, listings, review-platform visibility, and tools such as Marqii, establish standards and audit accuracy with Operations and restaurant teams.

* Work with Brand Managers and Creative Services to translate brand positioning and approved creative into useful, current digital experiences.
  

**CRM, lifecycle, and loyalty leadership**

* Lead the CRM, Lifecycle & Loyalty Efforts and agency relationship; set portfolio strategy, priorities, budget, service expectations, and measurement for guest data capture, segmentation, email/SMS, automation, retention, and loyalty.

* Ensure the day-to-day campaign execution, calendar coordination, list health, testing, automation, and loyalty program operations, in partnership with Brand Managers on brand voice, offers, and guest value.

* For Uchi’s 801 program, partner with the Uchi Brand Manager on proposition and brand experience and maintenance of the program.

* Connect acquisition and retention programs through a shared view of guest behavior, repeat rate, frequency, and lifetime value; maintain appropriate consent, data quality, and platform governance.
  

**Third Party and Off Premise Marketing and Leadership:**

* In partnership with Brand Managers, support the marketing and commercial partnership plan for third-party ordering and digital off-premise channels, including platform visibility, sponsored placements, digital merchandising, promotional plans, and marketing partner relationships.

* Analyze sales, traffic, conversion, promotion performance, and channel contribution; recommend investment and growth opportunities with Finance, Operations, and Brand Managers.

Partner with Operations as the accountable owner for delivery execution and economics.  



**Reporting and Optimization**

* Own growth and digital marketing budgets, forecasts, pacing, agency scopes, and vendor performance; coordinate with Finance and FP&A on consistent definitions and reporting.

* Create a concise performance scorecard for leadership and brand teams covering spend, attributed and incremental revenue where available, acquisition cost, conversion, web/search health, CRM contribution, and third-party channel marketing results.

* Turn analysis into clear actions, communicate performance and risks, and build repeatable planning and review rhythms across brands and markets.

* Manage the CRM function and agency partners through clear goals, feedback, prioritization, and accountability.
  

**DESIRED EDUCATION and QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in growth, performance, or digital marketing; experience leading multi-brand, multi-location, hospitality, restaurant, or consumer businesses strongly preferred.

* Demonstrated ownership of paid media budgets and measurable growth outcomes, with strong fluency in analytics, attribution, experimentation, and forecasting.

* Experience with website management, SEO/local search, digital conversion, online ordering or e-commerce, and agency/vendor management.

* Experience leading CRM or lifecycle teams and partnering across brand, creative, social, operations, and finance functions.

* Strong people leadership, project management, communication, and decision-making skills; able to translate complex performance data into clear recommendations.

* Experience in startup, lean, growth-oriented companies with proven results in building technology, systems, and marketing infrastructure.

* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Job Description Summary:**
============================

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and highly organized Brand Marketing & Social Media Assistant Manager to drive brand marketing initiatives across our beauty portfolio.  
  
This role will support the development and execution of integrated brand marketing strategies across social media, influencer marketing, digital campaigns, and product launches. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of beauty consumers and digital culture, with the ability to translate brand strategy and product priorities into compelling consumer-facing campaigns.  
  
This position will work closely with Brand, Product Development, PR, Creative, Performance Marketing, eCommerce, and external agency partners to strengthen brand awareness, consumer engagement, and overall brand growth.

**Job Description:**
====================

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute integrated brand marketing initiatives aligned with brand positioning, business objectives, and product priorities.
* Support the development of annual and seasonal brand marketing plans, including product launches, key brand moments, promotional campaigns, and always-on initiatives.
* Translate brand strategy and product positioning into clear consumer-facing messaging, campaign concepts, and content direction across marketing channels.
* Lead day-to-day social media strategy and execution across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and emerging platforms.
* Manage external social media and influencer agencies, including campaign briefs, content calendars, deliverables, timelines, and performance expectations.
* Review and provide strategic feedback on social content, creative assets, and campaign messaging to ensure brand consistency, quality, and consumer relevance.
* Develop and execute influencer and creator marketing strategies, including talent identification, outreach, product seeding, paid partnerships, campaign execution, and performance tracking.
* Build and maintain relationships with creators, brand ambassadors, agencies, and other strategic partners.
* Partner closely with Product Development and Creative teams to understand product concepts, key selling points, and launch priorities and translate them into effective marketing stories.
* Collaborate with PR, Performance Marketing, eCommerce, and Sales teams to ensure consistent brand messaging and integrated go-to-market execution across consumer touchpoints.
* Coordinate campaign content creation, photoshoots, influencer assets, and other marketing deliverables from briefing through final execution.
* Monitor beauty trends, competitive activity, social conversations, cultural moments, and consumer behavior to identify new brand and content opportunities.
* Track campaign and brand performance across social, influencer, and digital channels and translate results into actionable recommendations for future campaigns.
* Stay current on emerging marketing platforms, technologies, and AI tools that can improve creative development, consumer insights, and marketing workflow efficiency.

### **Knowledge / Experience / Skills / Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in brand marketing, social media, influencer marketing, digital marketing, or a related field, preferably within beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Strong understanding of brand marketing fundamentals, including brand positioning, consumer messaging, campaign development, product launches, and integrated marketing.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, influencer/creator ecosystems, and emerging digital platforms.
* Strong interest in and understanding of beauty trends, consumer behavior, social media culture, and the competitive beauty landscape.
* Experience working with external agencies, creators, creative teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, organizational, and project management skills.
* Strategic thinker with a hands-on execution mindset and the ability to turn insights and business priorities into actionable marketing initiatives.
* Experience with social media management, influencer marketing, analytics, or reporting platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with AI productivity and creative tools is plus.
* Proactive, collaborative, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of projects from concept through execution.

============

* Premium Medical Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Savings Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO) based on seniority
* Paid Holidays

**Additional Workplace Offerings (subject to change or eligibility.)**

* Annual Bonus Plan
* Onsite Employee Fitness Center with Indoor Racquetball Court and Yoga Room
* Summer Fridays
* Complimentary Gourmet Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
* Relocation Support for New Hires

* Visa Sponsorships (100% paid by the company) i.e., New H-1B, H-1B Transfer, O-1, and Green Card
* Commuter Support (Shuttle Bus Program and EZPass Support)
* Vehicle Perks

jobs.description:
**Is this job for you?**

We believe in doing things differently—building a brand that honors craftsmanship, fosters community, and creates positive impact. Our team brings day-one passion to everything we do, always innovating while staying true to what matters most: creating products and experiences that stand the test of time. We're looking for a strategic and creative Brand Marketing Director to lead the evolution of our brand voice, community engagement, and integrated marketing initiatives. This role is perfect for someone who can seamlessly blend strategic thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring every touchpoint—from social media to experiential activations—tells a cohesive, compelling brand story.

You'll work closely with our leadership team to build a marketing engine that drives awareness, deepens community connection, and creates memorable brand experiences across all channels.

  

**What you’ll do:**

**Brand Strategy & Guidelines**

* Uphold and steward our brand guidelines in partnership with leadership, including tone of voice, messaging principles, and visual identity standards
* Serve as a brand guardian, ensuring consistency across all channels and touchpoints while maintaining the flexibility to adapt to channel-specific needs
* Evolve our brand narrative to resonate authentically with our target audience

**Community Development & Engagement**

* Build and nurture our online community across social media platforms, creating spaces where our customers feel genuinely connected to the brand
* Engage meaningfully with followers, respond to inquiries, and foster conversations that strengthen brand loyalty

**Content & Copywriting**

* Create compelling copy across multiple formats: website content, social media, email campaigns, journal articles, print materials, and advertisements
* Ensure all messaging aligns with brand guidelines while resonating emotionally with our audience
* Bring our brand story to life through words that inspire and connect

**Social Media Strategy**

* Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies aligned with business objectives and brand identity
* Create integrated content calendars incorporating compelling visuals, engaging copy, and strategic hashtags
* Monitor performance metrics and optimize strategies to maximize reach, engagement, and conversion

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and cultivate partnerships with like-minded brands, influencers, and organizations (with initial focus on retail partnerships)

* Coordinate logistics, manage budgets, and measure success of experiential initiatives using tools like Measured or Marathon
* Create memorable brand experiences that generate organic buzz and deepen customer connection

**Integrated Marketing Leadership**

* Build a truly integrated cross-channel strategy where every tactic ladders back to the same core narrative, tone, and visual identity
* Develop one unified campaign calendar that maps all owned, earned, and paid touchpoints with clear dependencies and sequencing
* Collaborate early and often with creative, media, PR, social, retail, e-commerce, partnerships, and product marketing teams to ensure alignment from concept through execution

* Track holistic campaign performance against brand KPIs and sales goals, not just isolated channel metrics
* Serve as the brand discipline guardrail, ensuring speed and channel optimization never dilute our overarching message

**Retail/Wholesale Marketing & PR**

* Partner with wholesale and retail teams to build marketing strategies that support account growth, in-store activations, and channel-specific campaigns

* Lead PR campaigns tied to product launches, brand milestones, and cultural moments, partnering with leadership on messaging and positioning

* Minimum 10 years of experience in brand marketing, with a proven track record of developing and executing integrated marketing strategies
* Deep understanding of brand development, community building, and multi-channel marketing
* Strong copywriting skills with the ability to adapt tone and style across various formats and audiences
* Demonstrated success in social media strategy and community management

jobs.description:
The **Director Brand Marketing** will work closely with the VP of Digital Marketing to drive branding efforts on behalf of all Perdoceo institutions. This key position requires a successful brand marketing track record and a relentless focus on ensuring all teams and prospective students understand the value propositions for each of Perdoceo's diverse brands. This role must deliver in a strategic capacity but will also manage a team that must execute at the day to day level.

As a member of the Perdoceo Corporation marketing team this position is responsible for overseeing the implementation, execution and day-to-day management of branding efforts by partnering closely with internal departments, outside media agencies and vendors. The **Director Brand Marketing** should have a combination of branding, advertising, content and analytics skills in order to fuel efficient growth via performance marketing channels enabling each institution to reach strict monthly/quarterly business goals. The **Director Brand Marketing** plays an integral role across the organization and builds relationships with internal teams; including Media, Content, Compliance, Regulatory and Academics.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Set overall brand strategy and establish strategic, integrated campaigns to achieve business objectives; drive initiatives tied to the brand marketing functions including quarterly and yearly messaging/marketing planning and refreshes.
* Responsible for managing the branding process, driving efficiencies and ensuring quality for all assets that drive in market performance; oversight of brand guidelines, positioning and overarching creative development.
* Partner with internal marketing departments, operations departments and agencies to create a cohesive brand marketing strategy; work with compliance to ensure marketing flows and collateral are to Perdoceo standards.
* Oversee all institution events, managing entire planning process including event logistics, communications, branding and staffing.
* Manage internal communications ensuring marketing and broader teams understand each institution's brand positioning and messaging tactics
* Lead organic social team fostering engagement with current and prospective students alike while storytelling each institutions value propositions.

* Supervise team member projects to be completed on time and on budget

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing or relevant degree.
* Minimum 7 years of brand marketing experience; agency experience a plus.
* Self-motivated individual with an ability to navigate a complex, multi-layered, matrixed organization and create a collaborative environment among cross-functional departments.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Marketing Director leads the development and execution of marketing strategies that drive business growth, generate leads, strengthen customer engagement, and expand brand visibility. This role oversees marketing campaigns, digital growth initiatives, sales enablement, content development, market insights, and online reputation management. The Marketing Director partners with leadership and cross-functional teams to align marketing priorities with company objectives, improve marketing effectiveness, and support revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and lead the execution of marketing strategies aligned with company growth objectives and leadership priorities.
* Translate business goals into actionable marketing plans, campaigns, and initiatives.
* Establish marketing priorities, monitor performance, and adjust strategies based on results and business needs.
* Identify opportunities to improve brand awareness, market positioning, customer engagement, and lead generation.
* Oversee marketing resources and initiatives to ensure effective execution and measurable impact.

**Lead Generation & Sales Enablement**

* Lead marketing initiatives that support lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to strengthen pipeline development, customer retention, and account growth.
* Oversee the development of sales enablement materials, presentations, and content that support sales outreach and customer relationships.
* Direct CRM-enabled lead management, lead nurturing, and marketing-supported sales pipeline initiatives.
* Evaluate lead generation effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve conversion and engagement.

**Digital Marketing & Content Development**

* Oversee the company website, SEO strategy, and digital marketing initiatives to improve visibility, engagement, and conversion.
* Direct the development of marketing content that supports brand awareness, service positioning, and customer engagement.
* Ensure marketing materials and digital communications align with company brand standards and messaging.
* Monitor digital performance and implement improvements based on analytics, trends, and business objectives.

**Online Reputation & Google Reviews**

* Oversee the company’s online reputation and management of Google Business Profile reviews.
* Establish consistent practices for monitoring and responding to reviews in a timely, professional, and brand-aligned manner.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, and other relevant stakeholders to address negative feedback and resolve customer concerns.
* Identify recurring feedback and trends to highlight opportunities for improving customer experience and service quality.
* Develop initiatives to encourage authentic customer feedback and strengthen the company’s online reputation.

**Market Insights & Performance Analytics**

* Monitor market trends, customer feedback, competitive activity, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities.
* Establish and monitor relevant marketing performance indicators, including ROI, lead generation, conversion rates, website performance, and engagement.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and provide insights and recommendations to leadership.
* Use data to guide marketing decisions, optimize initiatives, and improve overall performance.

**Brand Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Oversee brand consistency across marketing materials, digital channels, and customer-facing communications.
* Partner with Brand & Communications to maintain consistent messaging and visual identity.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Product / Brand, and leadership to align marketing efforts with organizational priorities.
* Provide marketing support for company-wide initiatives, business development, and growth opportunities.
* Perform other related duties as needed to support organizational objectives.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

  

#### 

Day-to-day:

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

#### **You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

jobs.description:
**Position:** Marketing Analytics & Operations Specialist

**Shift:** Hybrid

**Position Overview:**

ValvTechnologies is seeking a detail-oriented Marketing Analytics & Operations Specialist to help drive data-informed marketing and business decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales, CRM administration, business intelligence, and analytics. The ideal candidate will consolidate marketing and sales data from HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics 365, transform complex datasets into actionable insights, and provide visibility into campaign performance, lead generation, account engagement, and revenue attribution.

The successful candidate will serve as a key resource for marketing reporting, dashboard development, ABM targeting, data quality management, and performance analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Analytics & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain recurring marketing performance reports.
* Analyze campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Measure funnel performance from inquiry through opportunity creation.
* Track and report on marketing-generated pipeline and revenue influence.
* Deliver insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
* Analyze and track Key Performance Indicators from our website and social media.

**CRM & Marketing Technology**

* Serve as a power user of HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Monitor data quality, duplicates, lifecycle stages, and reporting accuracy.
* Create and maintain lists, segments, scoring models, and audiences.
* Work with our agency HubSpot partner.

**Dashboard & Business Intelligence Development**

* Design interactive dashboards and reporting tools.
* Build KPI scorecards that provide visibility into:
  + Lead generation
  + Conversion rates
  + Campaign performance
  + Pipeline contribution
  + Customer engagement
  + Forecasting
* Automate reporting where possible to improve efficiency.

**Account-Based Marketing (ABM)**

* Support identification of target accounts.
* Analyze account engagement and campaign performance.
* Develop reporting that measures ABM effectiveness.
* Partner with sales leadership to refine targeting strategies.
* Collaborate with our pipeline digital agency partner.

**Attribution & Performance Measurement**

* Analyze customer journeys and conversion paths.
* Help identify the most effective channels, campaigns, and content assets.

**Sales & Marketing Alignment**

* Collaborate with sales leadership to improve visibility into lead and opportunity progression.
* Assist with lead scoring.
* Support territory, industry, and account analysis.
* Provide ongoing insights to improve marketing and sales effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing operations, CRM administration, or business intelligence.
* Experience working with HubSpot and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 or comparable sales CRM platforms.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills.
* Experience creating dashboards and visualizing data.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present findings to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power BI.
* Knowledge of marketing attribution models.
* Experience supporting Account-Based Marketing programs.
* Familiarity with B2B industrial manufacturing or technical sales environments.

We're looking for a strong writer, an excellent researcher, and a proactive problem-solver. You'll help execute marketing initiatives, support B2B growth, and keep projects on track without constant follow-up.

**What You'll Do**

* B2B prospecting: Research health plans, employers, brokers, and healthcare organizations. Build accurate prospect lists based on our ideal customer profiles (ICPs), identify decision-makers, and support outreach.

* HubSpot & campaigns: Maintain CRM records, organize contacts, create prospect lists, and help develop and execute email nurture campaigns.

* Content & PR: Distribute press releases, case studies, and marketing materials. Draft outreach emails, customer communications, and thank-you notes. Proofread materials for accuracy and brand consistency before they go out.

* Industry research & events: Identify relevant healthcare conferences, associations, speaking opportunities, sponsorships, and partnership prospects. Coordinate outreach and follow-up.

* Reporting: Research competitors and market opportunities, maintain trackers, and prepare weekly marketing reports, including updates for the COO, CEO, and board as requested.

* Creative support: Use Canva or Figma for simple graphics, presentations, and marketing materials.

* Executive support: Manage marketing priorities, coordinate meetings, capture action items, track deadlines, and follow up with stakeholders to keep projects on schedule.

* Team & vendor coordination: Schedule candidate interviews and work tests, track contractor deliverables and invoices, and keep shared files and brand assets organized.

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent written English, research, and communication skills.

* Hands-on HubSpot experience required.

* Experience with B2B prospecting, lead research, and email marketing.

* Working knowledge of Canva or Figma, Google Workspace, and Slack.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable.

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research and productivity, with strong fact-checking and quality control.

* Able to work independently, take initiative, and follow through.

* Trustworthy with confidential business information.

* Healthcare marketing experience is required.

**Schedule**

Regular overlap with U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours.

Please share a brief introduction and 1 to 2 examples of relevant marketing, research, CRM, or campaign work you've completed.

Before your interview, please review DrHouse's website so we can have an informed conversation about the role.

jobs.description:
### **Description**

As Chief Marketing Officer, you will shape how DRMP identifies opportunities, builds client relationships, and wins work. In engineering consulting, growth depends on understanding client priorities, positioning technical expertise, and bringing the right team to each pursuit. You will connect marketing, business development, market intelligence, and communications into a coordinated strategy that supports profitable growth and lasting client relationships.

This role combines strategic influence with hands-on leadership. You will partner with firm and operational leaders to decide where to compete, develop client and pursuit strategies, and coach technical professionals to communicate their value. You will also build the marketing and business development team’s capability and strengthen DRMP’s market presence. The opportunity is to shape both the growth strategy and the practices that turn it into results.

### **What you will lead:**

**Growth Strategy and Market Intelligence**

* Partner with firm leadership to translate business goals into focused market, client, and growth plans. Recommend where to invest, expand, or redirect effort based on opportunity, competitive position, and delivery capability.
* Track client capital plans, funding programs, procurement activity, legislation, and competitors to identify opportunities early and build a qualified pursuit pipeline.
* Guide go/no-go decisions with a clear view of client relationships, competitive positioning, pursuit investment, and the firm’s ability to win and deliver.
* Use pipeline, win-rate, client-growth, and pursuit data to assess results, challenge assumptions, and adjust priorities with operational leaders.

**Pursuit Strategy and Winning Work**

* Lead strategy for major pursuits, from early positioning through RFQ/RFP responses and interviews. Shape differentiated win themes around client priorities and the firm’s technical strengths.
* Provide hands-on direction on critical proposals and qualifications packages, ensuring persuasive writing, clear value propositions, and consistent quality.
* Coach technical leaders and interview teams on client engagement, presentation strategy, messaging, team selection, and rehearsal.
* Lead win/loss debriefs and apply the findings to improve pursuit selection, proposal quality, interview performance, and future results.

**Client Development and Account Growth**

* Partner with client and technical leaders to develop key-account plans, deepen relationships, and identify needs before opportunities are formally advertised.
* Equip technical professionals to build client relationships, ask effective questions, and turn insight into practical account and pursuit actions.
* Identify opportunities to bring additional services and expertise to clients. Track continuing services contracts and subsequent task orders to help account teams convert awards into sustained work.
* Gather client feedback, assess relationship health, and work with account teams to address concerns and follow through on commitments.

**Brand and Strategic Communications**

* Translate complex technical expertise and project outcomes into a clear, differentiated market position and compelling client-facing content.
* Direct thought leadership, public relations, digital marketing, social media, awards, and industry events in support of priority markets and client relationships.
* Coach leaders and subject-matter experts to communicate credibly with clients and industry audiences through presentations, articles, and speaking opportunities.
* Partner with the Chief People Officer on internal messaging and change communications, helping leaders explain business priorities while supporting the CPO’s ownership of internal communications.

**Team Leadership and Business Partnership**

* Build, lead, and develop the marketing and business development teams, with clear priorities, ownership, resource allocation, and accountability for results.
* Create trusted partnerships with operational and technical leaders. Influence across offices and disciplines, challenge constructively, and align teams around shared growth priorities.
* Strengthen team knowledge of the firm’s services, clients, and commercial priorities. Develop the team’s ability to advise pursuit and account leaders.
* Improve pursuit processes, CRM discipline, and knowledge sharing so teams can work consistently, use client intelligence, and adopt more effective ways of winning work.

  

### **What you bring:**

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 8+ years of progressive marketing, business development, or growth leadership experience in AEC, engineering consulting, environmental consulting, or a closely related technical professional services business. Comparable impact and scope will be considered.
* Experience leading a marketing or business development function, region, or business unit. Senior Directors and Vice Presidents ready for a broader remit are encouraged; a prior CMO title is not required.
* A measurable record of improving pursuit outcomes, client growth, or market position, with clear examples of personal ownership and partnership with technical leaders.
* Strong AEC pursuit expertise, including qualifications-based selection, RFQ/RFP strategy, proposal development, interview coaching, and pre-positioning. Able to connect marketing strategy with client development and winning work.
* Success leading and developing teams across offices, disciplines, or a matrixed organization, and coaching technical professionals in client engagement and business development.
* Strong commercial judgment, persuasive writing and presentation skills, and experience translating technical expertise into compelling positioning and communications.
* High emotional intelligence and credibility with senior leaders. Able to influence without direct authority, navigate resistance, and lead adoption of new processes while maintaining strong relationships

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.

**Data architecture & engineering**

* Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.

* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.

**Data quality, governance & enablement**

* Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
* Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

### **What will you bring?**

* 5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.

jobs.description:
About Future Finance

Future Finance is building the next generation of financial media: a daily newsletter that makes markets, investing, economics, and wealth creation engaging, actionable, and easy to understand for a modern audience.

Our goal is simple: become a daily habit for ambitious professionals who want to become smarter investors and better-informed consumers of financial information.

We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space.

The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter).
* Load and schedule 5 paid newsletter campaigns per week on Beehiiv.
* Assist with scheduling 1–2 daily email broadcasts for Decentralized Masters.
* Upload provided copy, subject lines, preview text, images, and links.
* Ensure campaigns are sent to the correct audience segments at the correct times.
* Thoroughly QA emails before scheduling, including formatting, links, tracking, segmentation, and send settings.
* Maintain campaign calendars and trackers.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, or potential mistakes before campaigns go live.
* Assist with last-minute scheduling changes when needed.
* Schedule/segment SMS broadcasts as we roll out SMS campaigns

  
**Requirements**  
  
Who You Are

Attention to detail is the #1 priority for this role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant supervision.

Key qualities:

* Excellent attention to detail: Catches mistakes in links, formatting, targeting, scheduling, Messaging (user experience), etc.
* Ownership and good judgment: Doesn't blindly follow instructions. Proactively flags anything that looks incorrect or unusual and asks questions when needed.
* Reliability: Consistently meets deadlines and ensures campaigns are ready on time.
* Organization: Can manage multiple brands, campaigns, and schedules without letting things slip.
* Ability to follow processes: Comfortable working with SOPs, checklists, and established workflows.
* Proactive communication: Flags blockers early rather than waiting until the last minute.
* Independent execution: Can take responsibility for recurring tasks after training.
* Tech-savvy and trainable: Comfortable learning new software and picking up tools quickly.

Experience Requirements

Prior experience with email marketing platforms is NOT required. We're happy to train the right person.

Experience with ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Beehiiv, or similar email marketing platforms is a plus, but what matters most is being detail-oriented, reliable, tech-savvy, and a fast learner.

What You Won't Be Responsible For

* Writing email copy or subject lines
* Developing email marketing strategies
* Creating offers or promotional campaigns

All copy, creative assets, and campaign instructions will be provided by the marketing team. Your role is to ensure everything is executed correctly.

Availability: Must be available and responsive between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) on working days to coordinate campaign scheduling, handle time-sensitive requests, and make any necessary adjustments.

 **Benefits**  
  
What do we offer

* Competitive salary
* Company offsites
* Remote work
* High ownership, high-impact role

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

  
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 Annually  
This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

**\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus
