jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Lifecycle Marketing Manager**

**Location:** Remote (candidate must be based in the US)  
**Type:** Contractor (20-30 hours/week)

  

**About the Role**

  

Our lifecycle agency has an immediate opening for a **Lifecycle Marketing Manager** with Iterable experience to own the end-to-end execution of high-performing, data-driven email campaigns. This role requires a strategic marketer with deep expertise in the **Iterable platform** and other ESPs like Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or Bloomreach, and proven success in lifecycle marketing. You will handle **all aspects of the email process**—from ideation and briefing to campaign set-up, QA, deployment, and performance reporting.

We’re looking for a **self-starter** who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative agency environment, communicates clearly, and can independently manage multiple concurrent projects. This role will require you to not only plan and strategize but also develop and launch campaigns. Experience using drag-and-drop tools, pre-existing email templates, and/or coordinating with a creative team is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full lifecycle of email marketing campaigns, from initial concept through deployment and reporting
* Independently configure and launch campaigns in Iterable using Studio’s drag-and-drop editor, modular templates, snippets, and dynamic data feeds to deliver personalized, scalable experiences
* Write or adapt campaign copy and select imagery when needed, ensuring messages are clear, compelling, and on-brand
* Conduct thorough QA—including rendering tests, link verification, and personalization logic checks—to ensure flawless execution
* Leverage Iterable’s analytics and experiment framework to monitor performance, run A/B and multivariate tests, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for optimization.
* Stay current on lifecycle marketing trends, new tools, and **AI-driven efficiencies** to improve workflow and campaign results
* Maintain clear, centralized documentation of Iterable workflows, templates, campaign assets, and performance insights for knowledge sharing and process continuity.

  

**Qualifications**

* **3+ years** of hands-on lifecycle marketing experience with a proven record of driving engagement and conversion
* **2+ years** of direct, advanced experience in **Iterable**, including workflow automation, segmentation, dynamic content, and reporting
* Ability to independently produce emails using drag-and-drop tools and template-based systems
* Understanding of email marketing best practices, deliverability, and compliance
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both strategy and execution
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote environment

  

**Pay Transparency**

Depending on skills and experience, the hourly rate for this contract role ranges from $50 to $60 per hour. As this is a contractor position, benefits are not provided, and contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, insurance, and any other associated expenses.

**Work Environment**

This is a contract position. Shaw/Scott is a 100% remote company, empowering our team members to do their best work from wherever they thrive. We offer a collaborative, flexible, and supportive culture that values innovation, inclusivity, and creativity.

**About Shaw/Scott**

At Shaw/Scott, we’re redefining what it means to be a modern company—built on collaboration, innovation, and passion. We believe in challenging conventions, inspiring our clients with visionary strategies, and creating an environment where big ideas thrive. Our team is dedicated to transforming digital marketing strategies while reimagining how great work gets done.

The **Sales Development & Marketing Manager** leads the Company’s sales development and marketing functions to drive revenue growth and new business opportunities. This role oversees the BDR and marketing teams, developing strategies to generate qualified leads, build pipeline, strengthen customer engagement, and support Airline’s business unit growth priorities. The manager partners with sales leadership, business unit leaders, and product management to translate target markets, capabilities, and commercial goals into coordinated sales development and marketing initiatives.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop the Business Development Representative team, setting goals, monitoring performance, and providing ongoing coaching.
* Develop and execute sales development strategies focused on target accounts, new leads, qualified opportunities, and pipeline growth.
* Oversee outbound prospecting, lead generation, qualification, and customer outreach.
* Establish qualification criteria to evaluate prospects and customers, prioritize continued investment, and recommend the appropriate coverage path: Outside Sales, TSA, House Account, or continued Business Development.
* Lead the marketing function, aligning campaigns and resources with sales priorities and business growth objectives.
* Oversee digital marketing, content, trade shows, events, and campaigns that drive lead generation and brand awareness.
* Partner with sales leadership to identify target markets, customer segments, growth opportunities, and expansion priorities.
* Work with Airline business unit leaders to develop business-unit growth plans, target accounts, lead-generation strategies, and market-development initiatives.
* Translate business unit capabilities, strategic vendor offerings, target industries, and value propositions into focused prospecting campaigns, content, and sales tools.
* Ensure effective handoff and follow-up of qualified opportunities across the sales organization.
* Drive CRM and marketing-tool discipline to ensure accurate lead data, activity tracking, and pipeline reporting.
* Coordinate with product management and sales to develop materials that strengthen customer engagement and support growth initiatives.
* Manage departmental priorities and resources in support of the Company’s growth objectives.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Sales, or a related field preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in sales development, business development, marketing, or a related commercial role.
* Experience managing or leading sales development representatives, marketing personnel, or similar teams.
* Experience developing lead generation strategies, managing sales pipelines, and supporting revenue growth.
* Knowledge of B2B sales and marketing strategies, including outbound prospecting, digital marketing, and lead qualification.
* Experience supporting multiple business units, product groups, or vertical markets and adapting sales development and marketing programs to distinct growth priorities.
* Experience with CRM systems, sales reporting, and marketing tools.
* Strong leadership, coaching, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to analyze performance metrics, identify trends, and implement improvements.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with sales leadership and cross-functional teams.

**Benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision/Disability effective first of the month after the hire date
* PTO accrual begins upon hire
* Referral bonuses
* 100% employee-owned plus 401k with company match

jobs.title: Marketing Campaign Specialist
jobs.description:
At the N2 Company, our vision is "*to be the most respected franchise in the nation, to share stories that build community, and to provide meaningful work for our team".*

**About Us**

The N2 Company is America's leading publisher of community magazines. We're proud of our award-winning media brands – they reach millions of readers in nearly every state and help great businesses connect with ideal clients – but we're even more proud to provide supportive and fulfilling remote work opportunities for our people.

  

**About The Role**

We're looking for a Marketing Campaign Specialist to turn reader interest into meaningful conversations with our Readership Engagement Specialists. You'll create and manage email, text, and social media campaigns that encourage readers to get involved with their community magazines. From building targeted audiences and crafting messages to testing campaigns and tracking results, you'll help turn interest into booked meetings.

Reporting to the Director of Content Operations, you'll work closely with our readership engagement and content teams to coordinate campaigns, support publication needs, and find ways to improve results. Your focus will be generating interest and scheduling conversations, while reader interviews and advertising sales are handled by their respective teams.

This role is fully remote. Interviews for this opening will be conducted over the phone and via video calls. The salary for this position is $50,000-$60,000 annually.

**The Role in Action**

* Create and manage reader outreach campaigns across email, text, and social media using tools like Instantly.
* Organize reader lists by publication and audience while maintaining accurate contact records and honoring consent and opt-out requests.
* Write engaging campaign messages and follow-ups that clearly explain the opportunity and how readers can participate.
* Set up and test campaign schedules, links, forms, and booking pages to ensure everything works properly before launch.
* Track campaign performance and test different audiences, messages, and timing to improve responses and booked meetings.
* Connect interested readers with the right Readership Engagement Specialist and provide the details needed for timely follow-up.
* Work with readership engagement and content teams to review results and improve meeting attendance, reader fit, and story opportunities.
* Maintain campaign settings and documentation, troubleshoot routine issues, and coordinate with Technology or vendors when additional support is needed.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We're looking for someone who will hit the ground running with:

* Experience creating and managing email, text, or social media campaigns.
* Familiarity with Instantly or similar email outreach tools and the ability to learn new platforms.
* Strong writing skills and a basic understanding of audience targeting, campaign testing, and email deliverability.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, reviewing campaign results, and maintaining contact records.
* Attention to detail when managing data accuracy, consent requirements, and opt-out requests.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, communicate clearly with teammates, and troubleshoot common issues.

**Skills and Qualities that Set You Apart:**

* Put readers first with relevant, respectful invitations.
* Own the details and ensure campaigns are ready to launch.
* Keep improving through testing, tracking results, and trying new approaches.
* Support your teammates with clear, helpful handoffs.
* Take ownership of problems and follow through on solutions.

  

### **Benefits Designed with You in Mind**

#### **Health & Wellness**

* Full **health care coverage** for you and your family.
* Complimentary basic **dental coverage**.
* Access to a **licensed nutritionist** to support your health and wellness goals.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)** with complimentary mental health resources and additional support services.

#### **Financial Security**

* **401(k) plan with a company match** to help secure your financial future.
* **Financial planning services** to guide you in achieving your financial goals.
* $7,000 contribution toward the purchase of your first home through our **First-Time Homebuyer Program.**

**Paid Leave**

* **Paid time off**, including a paid, **week-long Holiday Break** each year.
* **Three-week paid sabbatical** after four years of service.
* **Paternal leave**, including twelve weeks of paid maternity leave and two weeks of paid paternity leave.

#### **Remote Work Support**

* **Monthly remote-work reimbursement** to assist with home office and internet expenses.

#### **Additional Benefits**

* **Pet care insurance and discounts** to help support your pets' health and well-being.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
jobs.description:
Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
===============================================

About Assured Allies
--------------------

Aging well is both a health question and a financial one, yet most people are handed those challenges separately. At Assured Allies, we believe the only way to truly age well is to address both.

We partner with insurance carriers to help their policyholders stay healthier and more independent for longer. Our member program, NeverStop, delivers personalized coaching and simple daily actions that help people take an active role in their health and longevity.

We’re building for two very different audiences: adults in their 60s and 70s who are engaging with NeverStop, and the carrier executives, partners, and investors who work with Assured Allies. Our brands need to feel connected while speaking authentically to each audience.

That’s where you come in.

The Opportunity
---------------

We’re looking for a Brand & Marketing Designer to help define and own how both Assured Allies and NeverStop show up in the world.

On the NeverStop side, you’ll take an evolving brand foundation and extend it across everything outside the product experience—from the marketing website and campaigns to sales materials, email, social, and other member-facing communications.

For Assured Allies, you’ll help shape how the corporate brand evolves alongside NeverStop. You’ll work closely with Marketing and Corporate Development to establish where the two brands connect, where they should be distinct, and how they can feel like part of the same company without becoming interchangeable.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll design, build, and maintain the work yourself, including our marketing websites in Framer. You’ll also create the systems, templates, and standards that enable the broader team to produce high-quality, on-brand work without needing a designer for every request.

We’re particularly interested in someone who understands that designing for older adults requires thoughtful craft: excellent legibility, clarity, accessibility, and warmth—without relying on the clichés or condescension that too often appear in the category.

We’re open to starting with a contract or part-time engagement, with a clear path to full-time. We’re looking for a long-term design partner who wants to take meaningful ownership of the function, not a project-based agency relationship.

What You'll Do
--------------

* Own and evolve the **visual expression** of the Assured Allies and NeverStop brands across marketing and communications.
* Extend NeverStop’s brand system across websites, landing pages, sales materials, email, social, campaigns, and other marketing surfaces.
* Help define and develop the relationship between the NeverStop and Assured Allies brands.
* Design and maintain marketing websites and digital properties, primarily using Framer.
* Create high-quality sales decks, one-pagers, reports, presentations, campaign creative, and executive-facing materials.
* Partner with Marketing and Corporate Development on campaigns, storytelling, presentations, and other high-impact creative work.
* Collaborate with our product designer to ensure member-facing program content remains consistent with the broader NeverStop brand.
* Build and maintain a library of templates, guidelines, and design standards that enable teams to create on-brand materials independently.
* Establish efficient processes for managing multiple design requests and priorities across Marketing, Product, Corporate Development, and leadership.
* Use AI-assisted design and content tools thoughtfully to improve speed and efficiency while maintaining a high bar for quality and brand consistency.
* Bring strong visual and typographic judgment to everything you create.

What You'll Bring
-----------------

* 5+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or visual design, ideally within a technology-focused company.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating range across brand systems, websites and landing pages, presentations, reports, digital content, and campaigns.
* Experience building, evolving, or extending a brand system across multiple channels.
* Strong hands-on web design and implementation skills using a no-code platform such as Framer, Webflow, or a comparable tool. Direct Framer experience is a plus.
* The ability to work comfortably across both B2C and B2B audiences, adapting the visual language and storytelling to each.
* Strong visual, typographic, and systems-oriented design skills.
* Excellent judgment around brand consistency, especially when working across many contributors and touchpoints.
* Experience collaborating directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, resource-conscious environment.
* A thoughtful perspective on designing for older adults, with an appreciation for accessibility, legibility, clarity, and inclusive design.
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve creative workflows and production efficiency, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where human craft matters most.
* A high degree of ownership—you’re comfortable identifying what needs to be done and taking it from concept through execution.

### Nice to Have

* Experience in health, wellness, longevity, healthcare, insurance, or a related space.
* Experience with video, motion design, or storyboarding.
* Experience as an early or solo designer at a startup or other resource-constrained environment.
* Experience working across multiple related brands or developing brand architecture.

Compensation & Location
-----------------------

This role is open to starting as a contract or part-time engagement, with a path to full-time based on mutual fit and business needs.

The role is remote within the U.S., with a preference for candidates in the Boston, MA area and consideration for candidates elsewhere on the East Coast.

GO Car Wash opened its first tunnel in 2019 with one goal: to create a better car wash experience rooted in community, powered by people, and built on trust. AI is part of how modern teams do great work.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. **What We Do**

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.

* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.

* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.

jobs.title: Paid Media Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
jobs.description:
**About High Camp**
-------------------

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

**Head of Growth & Marketing**
------------------------------

### **About the job**

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you'll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You'll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

### **What you'll do**

* **Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.** Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
* **Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.** Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
* **Lead paid growth strategy.** Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
* **Run creative as a performance lever.** Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
* **Grow organic reach.** Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
* **Own retention and lifecycle.** Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You'll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you'll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
* **Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.** Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
* **Make marketing show up for the whole company.** Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
* **Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.** Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
* **Build the team.** Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

### **Key requirements**

* **Owned the number.** You've owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
* **Came up as an operator.** You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you've since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
* **Proven creative testing**. You've directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.

jobs.description:
Location  
Fully Remote

Schedule  
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation  
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to  
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type  
Full-time independent contractor

**About RevSpark Media**  
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

**About the Role**  
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

**Your First Focus**  
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

**What You'll Do**  
**Testing Strategy**

* Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
* Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
* Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
* Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

**Account Structure and Quality Standards**

* Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
* Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
* Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
* Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

**Strategic Direction**

* Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
* Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
* Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
* Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

**Performance Analysis**

* Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
* Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
* Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
* Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

**Client Support, As Needed**

* Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
* Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

**Why Work With Us**

* Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
* Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
* Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
* Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
* Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
* Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
* A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
* Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
* Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
* Strong written communication and documentation habits.

**Nice to have**

* Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
* Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
* Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
* Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

jobs.description:
**Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era**
=======================================

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

jobs.description:
We’re a global online booking platform operating across multiple country-specific domains, with a custom-built website (not WordPress or a template CMS) and a large, growing footprint of landing pages, country pages, city pages, and long-form blog content spanning dozens of markets.

We’re looking for an SEO specialist who’s comfortable working across both the technical and authority-building sides of SEO, roughly a 30/70 split: **30% basic backend and on-page technical work**, **70% quality backlink creation and content marketing**.

**What you’ll actually work on:**

*Technical & on-page (about 50%)*

* Working with our custom backend to fix on-page issues: meta tags, schema markup, canonical tags, hreflang across multiple country domains
* Coordinating with developers on indexing, crawl efficiency, Core Web Vitals, and page speed issues
* Auditing and cleaning up duplicate or thin content across a large, multi-domain site structure
* Comfortable reading audit tool output (Search Console, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar) and translating it into clear, prioritized fixes

*Backlinks & content marketing (about 50%)*

* Building genuine, relevant backlinks through outreach, guest content, and digital PR, not bulk or low-quality link networks
* Identifying and vetting link opportunities by real traffic and topical relevance, not just a domain authority number
* Repurposing and promoting content across the right channels to support both links and visibility
* Tracking and reporting on link quality, referring domains, and what’s actually moving rankings, not just volume

**What we’re looking for:**

* Real experience with both technical SEO fundamentals and hands-on link building, we need one person who can genuinely do both, not two half-skills
* Comfortable working on a custom-built website without a typical CMS plugin ecosystem to lean on
* Experience with multi-domain or multi-country SEO is a strong plus, understanding hreflang, regional targeting, and avoiding content cannibalization across markets
* Familiarity with Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics
* Someone who can explain their reasoning plainly, we care about understanding why something is being done, not just that it was done

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in travel, booking, or e-commerce SEO specifically
* Familiarity with AI search visibility and structured data for answer engines (schema, FAQ markup, and similar)

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply is a strategic, commercially focused role responsible for developing and advancing supplier-funded marketing partnerships that strengthen Classic Vacations' position in the luxury travel marketplace. Serving as the primary marketing account manager for assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other designated destinations, this position connects meaningful partner relationships with innovative marketing opportunities, measurable commercial outcomes, and sustainable revenue growth.

At the intersection of supplier relationship management, marketing strategy, and commercial development, the Marketing Account Manager – Supply leads partner discovery, annual co-op marketing planning, customized campaign recommendations, presentations, negotiations, and ongoing account engagement. By understanding each partner's objectives, commercial priorities, booking patterns, and destination needs, this role develops thoughtful marketing strategies that create mutual value while reinforcing Classic Vacations' luxury positioning and commitment to its Travel Advisor community.

The role also plays an important collaborative part in supporting Classic's European supplier marketing initiatives. Working alongside the Europe Supply team, the Marketing Account Manager contributes marketing expertise, campaign proposals, pricing and deliverable guidance, presentation development, execution coordination, and performance reporting. This partnership ensures European marketing initiatives benefit from consistent marketing expertise while maintaining clear regional relationship ownership within the Europe Supply organization.

Beyond relationship management, the Marketing Account Manager owns assigned co-op revenue goals, marketing pipeline development, forecasting, contractual coordination, and the successful transition of partner commitments into executable marketing campaigns. Working closely with Supply, Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Creative, Digital, and Finance, this role ensures supplier investments translate into well-coordinated initiatives that support advisor engagement, supplier production, and Classic's broader commercial objectives.

This is a relationship-driven, results-oriented role for someone who thrives on bringing people, ideas, and opportunities together. Success requires commercial curiosity, creativity, strong organizational discipline, trusted partnerships, and the ability to influence outcomes across departments through clarity, collaboration, accountability, and shared purpose.

Why This Role Matters

At Classic Vacations, our supplier partnerships are more than business relationships. They are an essential part of how we create extraordinary travel experiences, strengthen our value to Travel Advisors, and bring exceptional destinations, properties, and experiences to life. Behind every successful marketing campaign is an opportunity to connect the right partner, the right message, and the right audience in a way that creates lasting value.

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply helps transform those opportunities into meaningful commercial results. Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. * Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.

* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.

* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

Description:

DynamiX is seeking an in-office Technical SEO Specialist to improve organic visibility, technical website performance, and AI-search readiness across a portfolio of client websites.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how websites are built, how search engines evaluate them, and how to turn technical findings into practical improvements. **Responsibilities**

* Conduct technical SEO audits, identify issues, and prioritize clear recommendations.
* Improve site crawlability, indexing, page speed, mobile usability, internal linking, redirects, and site architecture.
* Implement and validate on-page SEO elements, including metadata, headers, image optimization, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data.
* Help optimize websites and content for AI-driven search experiences, including generative search results and answer-focused discovery.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Screaming Frog, and SEO platforms to monitor performance and uncover opportunities.
* Partner with designers, developers, content creators, and project teams to ensure SEO is incorporated into website builds, redesigns, and ongoing improvements.
* Review website content and page structure for keyword alignment, user intent, clarity, and conversion opportunities.
* Create concise client-facing reports and explain recommendations in straightforward, actionable terms.
* Stay current on search-engine updates, AI-search trends, and evolving best practices.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical SEO, website optimization, or closely related digital marketing experience.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, CMS platforms, website architecture, and how these affect search performance.
* Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Screaming Frog, and SEO research or monitoring tools.
* Experience implementing or guiding schema markup and structured data.
* Familiarity with AI tools and AI-search optimization practices.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple client priorities and collaborating across teams.
* Agency or multi-client experience is a plus.

**Details**

This is a full-time, in-office role based in the Cobb County metro area/Kennesaw. Compensation will be based on experience, technical depth, and overall role fit, and will be discussed during the interview process.

Interested in joining an amazing team of elite web professionals? DynamiX is a custom web house headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia (northwest of Atlanta). We are looking for a highly motivated, data-driven Paid Media Manager to own and elevate Axon's targeted paid advertising strategies. In this role, you will lead end-to-end strategy, execution, and continuous optimization across our paid digital channels.

Beyond channel management, you will serve as both an analytical steward and a persuasive creative force, crafting compelling, high-converting ad copy and integrating paid media channels directly into our reporting tools for transparent, real-time ROI tracking. ####

* Ensure alignment between paid programs and broader product and growth marketing initiatives, as well as paid and organic search strategies, for cohesive performance across all digital touchpoints.

* Craft copy that drives conversions. Collaborate with creative, web, and content teams on ad design, landing pages, and conversion rate optimization.

### **What You Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, directly managing performance-focused paid campaigns.

* Advanced hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, plus experience with additional paid channels such as programmatic, paid social, or ABM platforms.

* Strong analytical capabilities with a proven ability to translate complex datasets into actionable growth insights.
* Proactive, curious, solution-oriented, and highly collaborative mindset with exceptional attention to detail and campaign pacing skills.

### **Benefits that Benefit You**

* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all
* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Fitness Programs
* Emotional & Mental Wellness support
* Learning & Development programs

*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*

new_jobs.title: Manager, Performance Marketing
new_jobs.description:
**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**
----------------

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

**How the funnel is shared**
----------------------------

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

**What this role is accountable for**
-------------------------------------

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid Media Strategy & Performance**

* Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven
* Own budget pacing and allocation across all five ch

new_jobs.title: Marketing Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Make a difference by connecting people with natural options for better health.

At Renovation Integrative Health, we help people explore drug-free, nonsurgical care options so they can work toward feeling better and enjoying more of life. We’re looking for an outgoing, motivated person who wants to bring that opportunity to more people in our community.

Please read before applying: This is a face-to-face community outreach position—NOT a social media management, content creation, or digital marketing job. Social media is only a small, occasional supporting task. The primary work is getting out into the community, meeting people, building relationships, attending events, and scheduling appointments.

If you enjoy being out in the community and starting conversations with new people, this could be a great fit. Applicants seeking a primarily computer-based, remote, or social media position should not apply.

Your main responsibilities will include:

* Organizing and attending community events, health screenings, and dinner seminars.
* Visiting local businesses and building community partnerships.
* Talking with people about their concerns and introducing our services.
* Helping interested people schedule appointments.
* Following up with potential patients and community partners.
* Tracking outreach activity, appointments, and event results.

We’re looking for someone who:

* Enjoys approaching and talking with new people.
* Cares about helping others improve their quality of life.
* Takes initiative and follows through.
* Is organized, dependable, coachable, and motivated by results.
* Can travel locally and attend some evening and weekend events.

Experience in sales, community outreach, hospitality, fundraising, or event coordination is helpful. A healthcare background is welcome but isn’t required.

Compensation is production-based, with pay tied to approved outreach activities and results. Part-time and full-time opportunities are available.

Your next conversation could help someone take the first step toward getting help.

Apply with your résumé and a short note explaining why you would enjoy an active, face-to-face community outreach role.

Pay: $30,000.00 - $50,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**About Bizzabo**

Bizzabo is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

**About the role**

You'll own how Bizzabo is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo. Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

* Own positioning and messaging for the Event Experience OS. Translate new agentic capabilities into clear, provable value for enterprise event leaders, and keep the story consistent from the website to the last call before signature.

* Help us win competitive deals. Own competitive intelligence against legacy event management platforms and newer point solutions. Build battlecards, landmine questions, and objection handling that reps actually use, and run win/loss analysis to sharpen them.

* Own the context layer. Our messaging, product, and competitive knowledge powers the Claude Skills our teams use to write, sell, and support. You'll keep that source of truth current and use AI to automate your own GTM workflows.

**﻿What success looks like**

In your first 90 days:

* You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.
* You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.
* You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.
* You've shipped your first launch end to end.

In your first year:

* Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.
* Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.
* Our analyst and peer review position reflects where the product actually is.
* The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

**﻿What you need**

* An AI-native way of working. You've used AI agents, ideally Claude, to automate real GTM workflows, and you can show us what you built.
* A track record of positioning complex platforms for both business and technical buyers, and of winning against an entrenched incumbent.
* Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.
* Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.
* Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.
* Comfort building without a big team around you: you set your own priorities, move fast, and ship.

* Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in your day-to-day work.
